Lossy compression has been proposed to relieve bottlenecks but introduces workload-dependent accuracy loss, making it complex or even prohibitive to use in existing ML deployments. We explore lossless compression as an alternative that avoids this deployment complexity. We identify where lossless compression can be integrated into ML pipelines while minimizing interference with GPU execution. Based on our findings, we introduce Invariant Bit Packing (IBP), a novel lossless compression algorithm designed to minimize data transfer time for ML. IBP identifies and eliminates invariant bits across groups of tensors, improving throughput through GPU-optimized decompression that leverages warp parallelism, low-overhead bit operations, and asynchronous PCIe transfers. We provide easy-to-use APIs, showcasing them by adding IBP support to GNN training, as well as DLRM and LLM inference frameworks. IBP achieves, on average, 74% faster GNN training, 180% faster DLRM embedding lookup, and 24% faster LLM inference.

</details>


### [101] [DG-CoLearn: An Efficient Collaborative Learning Framework for Dynamic Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31427)
*Ashley Hoi-Ting Au,Zikun Zhang,Ligang He,Qiang Ni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DG-CoLearn 是一个面向动态图的协作学习框架，通过增量快照处理（仅更新受时间变化影响的图区域）实现高效的协作动态图学习。它在客户端不知情（client-oblivious）的可信服务器隐私模型下，通过服务器中介的嵌入交换机制实现精确的多跳消息传递，同时保护客户端间的结构隐私。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的动态图学习方法存在两大瓶颈：(1) 每次时间戳都需对完整图快照进行重训练，计算开销巨大；(2) 现有联邦/协作图学习方法假设客户端子图不相交或完全可见跨客户端连接，不适用于现实中的分区数据场景。此外，传统联邦学习关注的是"客户端-服务器"隐私，而现实中许多系统（如金融平台、基础设施网络）由可信中央协调者维护全局拓扑，隐私风险主要存在于客户端之间——这一隐私维度尚未被充分研究。

Method: DG-CoLearn 围绕"增量快照处理"这一核心原则，包含三个关键组件：(1) **CoLearnPartition**：双阶段时序图分区算法，第一阶段硬约束最小化跨客户端边（cut edges），第二阶段软优化分区平衡与标签多样性，固定历史分配仅增量分配新节点；(2) **轻量级本地动态 GNN 训练**：基于 ROLAND 的 GRU 状态更新机制，对受 delta 图影响的 k-hop 诱导子图进行 GNN 消息传递，未变化节点的状态直接从 t-1 时刻复用；(3) **服务器中介的嵌入交换机制**：通过定理证明的精确 1-hop 和 2-hop 嵌入重构公式（Theorem 4.1），客户端仅向服务器提交 0-hop 和 1-hop 嵌入，服务器利用全局拓扑计算精确的多跳嵌入修正后返回，通信复杂度从 O(|V_t|) 降至 O(|ΔV|)。同步策略采用首轮仅交换一次以平衡性能与开销。隐私分析证明即使多客户端合谋也无法从聚合嵌入中恢复其他客户端的子图结构。

Result: 在 6 个标准数据集（UCI、OTC、DBLP3、DBLP5、Reddit、AS-733）和 2 个大规模 TGB 基准（tgbl-coin 22M 边、tgbn-reddit 27M 边）上的实验表明：DG-CoLearn 在链路预测任务上较 ROLAND 提升最高 518% MRR 和 8.27% MAP；在节点分类任务上较 FedDGL 提升最高 13.36% F1；训练时间加速高达 33.8×，通信开销降低 27.4×。在 tgbl-coin 上，全图重训练基线无法完成而 DG-CoLearn 可运行；在 tgbn-reddit 上 cut edge ratio 降低 76.8%，F1 提升 11.98%。消融实验显示嵌入交换机制在跨客户端边预测上较 FedGCN 提升最高 11.7% MAP，增量处理较全图交换加速最高 6.3×。

Conclusion: DG-CoLearn 证明通过统一的增量快照处理原则贯穿分区、本地训练和跨客户端嵌入重构三个阶段，可以在保持或提升预测性能的同时大幅提升效率，并严格保护客户端间结构隐私。其形式化的"客户端不知情"隐私范式填补了现有联邦图学习（关注客户端-服务器隐私）的空白，表明协作 DGL 中隐私与精度的张力并非根本性矛盾，而是源于将各挑战孤立对待而非联合设计。局限包括依赖可信服务器、限制 2-hop 跨客户端消息传递、尚未扩展至十亿边规模。

Abstract: Dynamic graph learning (DGL) is essential for modelling evolving graph data, but existing methods suffer from significant computational overhead due to repeated full-snapshot retraining and are not well-suited for collaborative settings with partitioned data. In realistic graph systems, cross-partition edges are unavoidable, but direct sharing of graph structure between clients may violate privacy constraints. We propose DG-CoLearn, a client-oblivious collaborative dynamic graph learning framework built on incremental graph snapshot processing, which focuses computation on graph regions affected by temporal updates while preserving historical information through temporal modelling. This incremental design is consistently applied across the entire graph processing pipeline, including a server-mediated embedding exchange mechanism to enable accurate multi-hop message passing without exposing raw cross-client structural information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DG-CoLearn achieves up to 33.8$\times$ speedup in training time and 27.4$\times$ reduction in communication overhead, while consistently improving predictive performance on both node classification (up to 13.36% F1 improvement) and link prediction (up to 8.27% MAP improvement) tasks. These results highlight the effectiveness of DG-CoLearn in bridging efficiency, scalability, and client-to-client structural privacy in collaborative dynamic graph learning.

</details>


### [102] [Automating Formal Verification with Reinforcement Learning and Recursive Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30914)
*Max Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MIT硕士论文，研究如何利用验证器环境通过RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）和验证器引导的推理时搜索来提升LLM生成已验证程序和证明的能力。研究分为两部分：Dafny上的后训练（GRPO等RL方法）和Lean上的推理时脚手架（递归分解、验证器反馈、工具调用、进度评估），并引入了新的Dalek-Bench基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化形式验证对LLM具有挑战性，原因在于：(1) 证明助手和验证感知语言的数据稀缺；(2) 正确性依赖于满足精确的机器可检查规范，而非仅生成看似合理的代码。虽然LLM在形式数学定理证明（如AlphaProof、DeepSeek-Prover、Goedel-Prover等）方面取得了显著进展，但形式软件验证是一个更难的问题：需要同时构思规范和实现，已验证代码的语料库比数学证明库小得多，且解决方案和"证明路径"的空间结构化程度较低。该论文旨在研究这些技术能否从形式数学迁移到自动生成已验证软件这一更困难的领域。

Method: 论文围绕两个互补方向展开：第一部分（后训练，Dafny环境）使用GRPO及其变体进行RLVR训练，将生成的候选程序组装成完整程序并用编译器和验证器结果进行评分；通过SFT在精选Dafny示例上建立更强的基础知识；构建多轮训练环境以暴露模型于多轮修复尝试；通过更强模型的rollout进行蒸馏。第二部分（推理时脚手架，Lean环境）构建递归代理，将困难验证问题分解为可独立解决的子问题；引入智能工具调用（提供类型签名、库文档、相关引理等上下文）和进度评估器（监控推理是否有进展，截断消耗大量token的死胡同）；利用证明修改器（proof reviser）进行验证器反馈驱动的修复。还引入了基于Rust curve25519-dalek验证项目的仓库级Lean基准Dalek-Bench。

Result: Dafny部分：在APPS衍生的Dafny数据集上，RLVR将验证奖励从2.2%提升至58.1%，但发现了规范黑客攻击（specification hacking）问题——模型利用弱形式规范而非实现预期解决方案。过滤欠规范和有漏洞的任务后，多轮RLVR在精炼基准上将验证通过率从9.7%提升至31.1%。Lean部分：完整的脚手架配合证明修改器在VeriCoding初始试点集上将通过率从46.2%（直接修复）提升至69.2%；在更大的VERINA数据集上，整体任务分解加证明修改器解决了42个先前未解决任务中的7个。Dalek-Bench的初步结果仍然较弱，表明需要更强的进度评估和任务特定的工具使用策略。

Conclusion: 当形式验证器不仅被视为检查器、还被视为奖励、反馈和搜索控制的来源时，它们对LLM变得有用。然而，这仅在环境提供干净数据、健壮规范和结构化的方式来响应验证器反馈时才成功。论文的核心贡献包括：(1) 对已验证代码生成后训练的实证研究，包括RLVR、规范黑客分析、数据集过滤和多轮验证器反馈训练；(2) Lean已验证编码的推理时脚手架系统，结合递归分解、验证器反馈、工具访问和进度评估；(3) Vericoding基准评估和新引入的Dalek衍生已验证代码基准。论文揭示了形式验证LLM化的几个关键设计原则：数据质量、反馈粒度和搜索结构化程度。

Abstract: Automated formal verification remains challenging for large language models because data for proof assistants and verification-aware languages is scarce, and correctness depends on satisfying precise machine-checkable specifications rather than producing plausible code. This thesis studies how verifier environments can improve LLM generation of verified programs and proofs through reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) and verifier-guided inference-time search. First, we train open-source models in Dafny with RLVR using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and related variants, assembling generated candidates into complete programs and scoring them with compiler and verifier outcomes. Initial experiments on an APPS-derived Dafny dataset increased verified reward from 2.2% to 58.1%, but revealed specification hacking, where models exploit weak formal specifications instead of implementing the intended solutions. After filtering underspecified and vulnerable tasks, multi-turn RLVR on the refined benchmark improves the verified pass rate from 9.7% to 31.1%. Second, we develop a verifier-guided inference scaffold in Lean that treats proof generation as structured search over decomposed subgoals, verifier feedback, diagnostics, and repair. With a fixed base model, the full scaffold with proof reviser improves pass rate on an initial VeriCoding pilot set from 46.2% under direct repair to 69.2%. On the larger VERINA dataset, whole-task decomposition plus proof reviser solves 7 of 42 previously unsolved tasks. We also introduce Dalek-Bench, a repository-scale Lean benchmark derived from the Rust $\texttt{curve25519-dalek}$ verification project; preliminary results remain weak, indicating that stronger progress evaluation and task-specific tool-use policies are still needed.

</details>


### [103] [QASM-Eval: A Dataset to Train and Evaluate LLMs on OpenQASM-3 Beyond Quantum Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30358)
*Zhenxiao Fu,Lei Jiang,Fan Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QASM-Eval 是首个针对 OpenQASM-3 硬件面向特性（经典逻辑、时序调度、脉冲控制及复杂实际工作流）的大语言模型训练与评估基准数据集，包含 100 个专家验证的测试任务和 4,000 个训练任务，配套自动验证器（语法+量子态+时间线检查）。实验表明当前 SOTA LLM 在 OpenQASM-3 编码任务上表现较差，但基于该数据集的 LoRA 微调可使 Llama-70B 达到 85% pass@1，超越少样本 GPT-5.2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NISQ 时代量子计算受噪声严重制约,缓解噪声需要超越门序列电路规范的硬件级能力:量子纠错所需的中路测量与经典反馈、动态解耦所需的精确时序控制、标定所需的脉冲级波形访问。OpenQASM-3 引入了这些能力,但现有 OpenQASM 相关数据集（如 QASMBench、Veri-Q、QCircuitBench、Agent-Q）要么面向算法/硬件基准,要么局限于门序列电路,缺乏同时针对 LLM 代码生成且覆盖 OpenQASM-3 核心新特性（经典逻辑、时序调度、脉冲控制）的训练/评估资源。

Method: （1）任务分类：四类各 25 个测试/1000 个训练任务——经典逻辑（if/else、while/for 循环、switch、位运算等）、时序调度（delay、duration、stretch、alignment、box）、脉冲控制（waveform calibrate/rewrite、shift_phase、调制、自定义波形、多路读出等）、复杂任务（QEC、DD、标定等综合场景）。（2）构建流水线：专家设计背景模板（随机化量子比特配置/频率/默认门序列）与核心任务模板（含占位符）→ 用 Qwen3-Coder-480B 结合 OpenQASM-3 文档生成结构变体并经专家审核 → 随机化实例化 → LLM 生成 TODO 自然语言描述 → 形成（规约-解）对。测试集使用一种变体,训练集使用其余变体以防泄露。（3）自动验证器：官方解析器检查语法（含所需结构元素）;扩展前端支持 OpenQASM-3 新语义,基于 Qiskit 态矢量和 QuTiP 脉冲模拟检查量子态分布;为支持操作分配默认时长并暴露覆写接口,检查虚拟时间线;使用 pass@k 指标。（4）评估对象:GPT-5.2-Thinking、DeepSeek-V3、Llama-3-70B/8B,对比零样本、3-shot、LoRA 微调（QCircuitBench/Agent-Q/QASM-Eval）三种设置,2×H100 训练,3 epoch,LoRA rank=8,lr=1e-5。

Result: （1）基础模型表现有限:GPT-5.2 总分 0.54,脉冲控制最强（0.92）但复杂任务仅 0.08;Llama-70B/8B 分别 0.27/0.24,复杂任务 0。（2）3-shot 提示带来显著提升:GPT-5.2-fs 总体 0.78,复杂任务从 0.08 跃升至 0.64。（3）QASM-Eval 微调带来最大增益:llama70b-ours 总体 0.85、复杂任务 0.64,超越少样本 GPT-5.2;llama8b-ours 从 0.24 提升至 0.52,接近 GPT-5.2 零样本水平;QCircuitBench/Agent-Q 微调仅带来边际甚至负向改进。（4）错误分析显示微调主要降低语法错误（Llama-70B: 311→8;Llama-8B: 244→75）,pass@1 变化与语法成功率强相关。（5）验证器与专家标注一致性 92%,Cohen's κ=0.837,差异主要源于 TODO 描述的解读歧义。

Conclusion: QASM-Eval 填补了 OpenQASM-3 硬件面向特性 LLM 训练与评估的关键空白,提供了从规约-解对到自动验证的完整基础设施。在该数据集上微调可使中等规模开源模型超越少样本增强的 GPT-5.2,表明语法掌握仍是当前 LLM 的主要瓶颈,语义约束遵循是下一阶段挑战。未来工作应拓展至算法级推理与仓库级真实代码评估。

Abstract: Quantum computing remains in the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era, where the performance is highly constrained to noise. Addressing the limitation often requires hardware-facing capabilities beyond gate-sequence circuit specification, including mid-circuit measurement and classical feedback for quantum error correction (QEC), precise timing control for dynamical decoupling (DD), and pulse-level waveform access for calibration. OpenQASM-3 was introduced to expose exactly these capabilities, providing a hardware-level programming interface. However, despite the rapid progress of large language models in code generation, there is still no dataset specifically designed to train and evaluate LLMs on OpenQASM-3 programs that involve its advanced hardware-oriented features. To address this gap, we introduce QASM-Eval, the first comprehensive dataset designed to train and evaluate LLMs on OpenQASM-3. Rather than focusing on quantum algorithm design or reasoning, QASM-Eval explicitly targets the language's hardware-facing features. QASM-Eval comprises an expert-verified test set of 100 tasks and a training set of 4,000 tasks, systematically covering classical logic, timing scheduling, pulse control, and complex real-world workflows. To automatically validate generated programs, we check syntax, quantum states and program timeline using an extended verifier. Our evaluation reveals that while state-of-the-art LLMs struggle heavily in OpenQASM-3 coding tasks, targeted fine-tuning on QASM-Eval yields significant gains. QASM-Eval provides a crucial benchmark and training foundation to accelerate the development of reliable LLM assistants for hardware-facing quantum programming in NISQ era. Data and code: this https URL

</details>


### [104] [Gait2Hip-60: A Unified Deep Learning Benchmark for Predicting Hip Muscle Forces and Joint Moments from Multi-Cadence Gait Kinematics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30374)
*Jiaqi Zhang,Ji Hou,Qing Sun,Xianzhi Gao,Bo Huo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于深度学习（比较LSTM、Transformer和Mamba三种序列模型）的框架，可直接从下肢步态运动学参数预测髋关节肌肉力和关节力矩，并在健康人和股骨头坏死（ONFH）患者上进行了验证。结果显示Transformer模型表现最佳，在健康人测试集上达到了较高的预测精度，并在ONFH患者上表现出一定的零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的髋关节动力学参数（肌肉力、关节力矩）估计依赖于OpenSim等肌肉骨骼仿真，虽然信息丰富，但耗时且难以在临床中推广应用。研究旨在探索深度学习方法能否直接从易于采集的下肢关节角度快速、准确地预测这些参数，以降低临床应用门槛。

Method: 采集60名健康成人在三种节拍器引导步频下的步态数据，提取10个双侧下肢关节角度作为输入，以OpenSim计算的髋关节肌肉力和关节力矩作为参考输出。在统一的数据划分（受试者级）、预处理流程和评估指标下，训练并比较了LSTM、Transformer和Mamba三种序列模型。最佳模型直接应用于9名股骨头坏死（ONFH）患者外部队列进行零样本测试（不进行重新训练）。

Result: 在健康受试者基准测试中，Transformer在髋关节肌肉力预测（RMSE = 1.33 N/kg，MAE = 0.57 N/kg，R² = 0.819）和髋关节力矩预测（RMSE = 0.11 Nm/kg，MAE = 0.07 Nm/kg，R² = 0.862）上均取得了最佳的平均性能，并在不同步频下保持优势。在零样本外部验证中，Transformer在ONFH患者上保留了中等预测能力（肌肉力R² = 0.537，力矩R² = 0.569）。

Conclusion: 研究证明了从步态运动学参数直接估计髋关节动力学的可行性，并确立了Transformer作为该任务的强基线模型。然而，跨病理群体的泛化性能仍有限，表明在临床应用前需要进行更广泛的病理数据验证和模型泛化能力改进。

Abstract: Estimating hip muscle forces and joint moments during gait typically relies on musculoskeletal simulation, which is informative but time-consuming and difficult to apply in clinical settings. This study developed a deep learning framework to predict these hip dynamics parameters directly from lower-limb gait kinematics and compared three representative sequence models under a unified protocol. Gait data were collected from 60 healthy adults under three metronome-guided cadence conditions. Ten bilateral lower-limb joint angles were used as inputs, and OpenSim-derived hip muscle forces and hip joint moments were used as reference outputs. Three deep learning models of LSTM, Transformer, and Mamba were trained and evaluated using the same subject-level split, preprocessing pipeline, and metrics. The best model was then directly tested on an external cohort of 9 patients with osteonecrosis of the femoral head (ONFH) without retraining. In the healthy-subject benchmark, Transformer achieved the best subject-level mean performance for both hip muscle force prediction (RMSE = 1.33 N/kg, MAE = 0.57 N/kg, R2 = 0.819) and hip joint moment prediction (RMSE = 0.11 Nm/kg, MAE = 0.07 Nm/kg, R2 = 0.862), with similar advantages across walking cadences. In zero-shot external validation, Transformer retained moderate predictive ability in ONFH for hip muscle force prediction (RMSE = 1.51 N/kg, MAE = 0.70 N/kg, R2 = 0.537) and hip joint moment prediction (RMSE = 0.17 Nm/kg, MAE = 0.12 Nm/kg, R2 = 0.569). These findings support the feasibility of estimating hip dynamics from gait kinematics, identify Transformer as a strong baseline, and highlight the need for broader pathological validation and improved generalization before clinical application.

</details>


### [105] [A Novel Evaluation Metric for Unsupervised Learning in AIS-Based Maritime Anomaly Detection: MADQI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30388)
*Ismet Gocer,Zakirul Bhuiyan,Raza Hasan,Shakeel Ahmad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于海事自动识别系统(AIS)数据异常检测的新系统框架，并设计了一种无需标签数据的复合评估指标MADQI（海事异常检测质量指数），用于评估无监督异常检测模型的性能，实验在AIS数据集上取得了80.37%的MADQI分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海事AIS数据中的异常船舶行为（速度、位置跳跃、时间间隔和转向角度异常）对航运安全和监管至关重要。尽管Isolation Forest等无监督学习方法被广泛使用，但缺乏系统化、有意义的评估指标，亟需一种无需标签数据的模型性能评估框架。

Method: 1. 基于Isolation Forest的无监督异常检测算法；2. 使用Haversine距离计算分析AIS数据的空间特征；3. 提出MADQI复合评估指标，整合四个互联子指标：异常率一致性(ARC)、物理合理性分数(PPS)、分数分布分离度(SDS)和极端情况证据(ECE)；4. 通过多块评估(multi-chunk evaluation)和自适应缩放(adaptive scaling)技术进行自动归一化融合。

Result: 在AIS数据集上的实验表明，框架达到了80.37%的MADQI分数；在各子指标中，ECE得分0.907（极端异常检测能力优秀），ARC得分1.000（异常率一致性完美），验证了该框架在无监督异常检测评估中的有效性和可靠性。

Conclusion: 所提出的MADQI框架为无监督海事AIS异常检测提供了一种可靠且有意义的评估方法，能够有效识别异常船舶行为，弥补了无监督学习评估缺乏系统化指标的空白。

Abstract: This paper introduces a new systematic framework for detecting anomalies in maritime Automatic Identification System (AIS) datasets. These anomalies include abnormal vessel behaviours related to speed, position jumps, time gaps, and turn angles. Although unsupervised learning algorithms such as Isolation Forest are widely used for detecting anomalous vessel movements, they often lack systematic and meaningful evaluation measures. To address this limitation, we propose a novel quality metric called Maritime Anomaly Detection Quality Index (MADQI). The prosed MADQI is a composite index designed to evaluate the anomaly detection performance of machine learning models without requiring labelled data. The proposed framework uses Haversine distance calculations to analyse AIS datasets and identify anomalies based on their spatial and behavioural characteristics. The proposed MADQI evaluation framework integrates four interconnected metrics: Anomaly Rate Consistency (ARC), Physical Plausibility Score (PPS), Score Distribution Separation (SDS), and Extreme Case Evidence (ECE). These metrics are combined through automatic normalisation using multi-chunk evaluation and adaptive scaling techniques. Experimental results on the AIS dataset show that the proposed framework achieved a MADQI score of 80.37%, demonstrating its effectiveness for unsupervised anomaly detection. In particular, the algorithm performed strongly in identifying abnormal vessel behaviour. Among the individual MADQI components, ECE and ARC achieved scores of 0.907 and 1.000, respectively, indicating excellent capability in detecting extreme anomalies and maintaining anomaly rate consistency. Overall, these results are encouraging and demonstrate that the proposed framework provides a reliable and meaningful approach for evaluating unsupervised anomaly detection in maritime AIS data.

</details>


### [106] [Bounded Behavioral Indistinguishability for Black-Box LLM Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30448)
*Munawar Hasan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"有界行为不可区分性"框架，将黑盒LLM蒸馏评估从输出相似度问题转化为对抗性区分优势问题，在Qwen和Llama师生对上验证了LoRA蒸馏虽提升语义相似度但无法消除可检测的行为差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有黑盒LLM蒸馏评估主要依赖输出相似度指标（语义相似、任务一致性等），但输出相似并不等于行为不可区分——一个学生模型可能在保留主要内容的同时泄露风格/格式/安全策略等可检测痕迹，这可能导致对蒸馏效果的过度乐观估计。论文借鉴密码学中基于游戏的安全定义思想，将行为不可区分性形式化为有界的、可操作的、相对特定威胁模型的实证主张。

Method: 1) 形式化定义：(ε, q, t, 𝔸)-行为不可区分性，其中ε为区分优势上界，q为查询预算，t为计算预算，𝔸为对抗类；2) 构建5,000提示的行为探针套件，覆盖10个行为类别；3) 在Qwen2.5-3B→0.5B和Llama-3.2-3B→1B两对师生模型上，通过黑盒LoRA蒸馏生成学生；4) 部署多种经验性对抗器：prompt-only/response-only/prompt-response/embedding判别器（基于DistilBERT和RoBERTa）、策略级评估器、跨家族Llama成对判断器（含A/B位置偏置过滤）；5) 比较分层随机采样与分歧引导查询获取策略的查询效率。

Result: 1) 语义相似度提升：Qwen从0.788→0.862，Llama从0.814→0.874；2) 判别器优势下降但未消除：Qwen DistilBERT准确率从0.778降至0.598，Llama RoBERTa准确率从0.657降至接近随机的0.499；3) 成对教师识别：Qwen在跨家族Llama判断器下优势从0.158降至0.081（降幅约49%）；4) 残差区分性集中在风格/格式、鲁棒性扰动和领域技术提示类别；5) 分歧引导查询获取未一致优于分层随机采样，表明覆盖率和多样性仍是强基线。

Conclusion: 语义保真度对黑盒LLM蒸馏评估而言必要但不充分；行为不可区分性需通过有界的、对抗性的、类别感知的评估来衡量。该框架将评估问题从"输出有多相似"转变为"在显式查询、计算和对抗类约束下，对手能否区分教师与学生"，为黑盒蒸馏提供了更严格、更可解释的评估视角，但所有声称均为相对特定提示分布、查询预算和对抗类的有界实证主张而非通用保证。

Abstract: Black-box LLM distillation is usually evaluated as an output-matching problem: a student is considered successful when its responses are semantically similar to, or task-consistent with, those of a teacher. However, output similarity does not imply that the student is behaviorally indistinguishable from the model it imitates. We introduce bounded behavioral indistinguishability, formalized as $(\epsilon,q,t,\mathbb{A})$-behavioral indistinguishability over an explicit prompt distribution, where $\epsilon$ bounds distinguishing advantage, $q$ bounds oracle queries, $t$ bounds computation, and $\mathbb{A}$ denotes the adversary class. We instantiate this notion on Qwen and Llama teacher-student pairs using a controlled $5,000$-prompt behavioral probe suite. For each family, we compare the teacher with both the base student and the LoRA-distilled student, measuring whether distillation reduces distinguishability rather than merely improving similarity. LoRA raises semantic similarity from $0.788$ to $0.862$ for Qwen and from $0.814$ to $0.874$ for Llama. Yet adversarial evaluation reveals remaining behavioral differences: learned discriminators retain nonzero advantage, and pairwise category analysis shows artifacts concentrated in style/format, robustness, and domain-technical prompts. A pairwise teacher-identification adversary confirms this trend. With a different-family Llama judge and A/B-swap consistency filtering, Qwen distinguishing advantage drops from $0.158$ for the base student to $0.081$ after LoRA distillation. Query-budget experiments show that disagreement-guided acquisition does not consistently outperform stratified random sampling, indicating that coverage and diversity remain strong baselines. Our results show that semantic fidelity is useful but insufficient: black-box LLM distillation requires bounded, adversarial, and category-aware evaluation.

</details>


### [107] [VeriGate: Verifier-Gated Step-Level Supervision for GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30451)
*Aakriti Agrawal,Minghui Liu,Furong Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VeriGate是一种基于验证器门控的GRPO扩展方法，通过在验证器奖励退化为零时引入过程奖励模型（PRM）提供的步级监督，将PRM分数转化为未来累积奖励并生成组归一化的token级优势函数，以解决GRPO监督稀疏和缺乏细粒度信用分配的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO依赖基于验证器的结果奖励进行训练，当同一提示的所有采样轨迹获得相同奖励时，组相对优势归零导致学习停滞；此外，结果奖励无法提供步级信用分配，限制了探索能力和鲁棒推理的学习。

Method: 提出三项设计：(1) 验证器门控——当验证器奖励能在采样轨迹间产生有意义偏好时由验证器主导，仅在奖励退化时启用过程监督；(2) 将PRM步级分数转换为未来累积奖励以实现延续感知的信用分配；(3) 将这些奖励转化为组归一化的token级优势函数，恢复信息梯度并实现细粒度信用分配。

Result: 在MATH数据集上使用Qwen2.5-Instruct 1.5B和7B模型训练，并在6个推理基准上评估：1.5B模型平均准确率提升约20%，7B模型提升约12%；同时显著降低零梯度失败、减少奖励欺骗行为，并相对于仅使用结果奖励的GRPO及将PRM作为结果的基线方法提升了推理质量。

Conclusion: VeriGate通过验证器门控机制、延续感知的过程奖励和token级优势归一化，有效缓解了GRPO的监督稀疏与奖励欺骗问题，为推理模型的强化学习训练提供了一种更稳定、信息更丰富的优化方案。

Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is an effective recipe for training reasoning models with verifier-based outcome rewards, but its supervision is sparse: when all sampled trajectories for a prompt receive the same verifier reward, the group-relative advantage collapses to zero and learning stalls. Outcome-only rewards also provide no step-level credit assignment, limiting exploration and making it harder to learn robust reasoning. We present VeriGate (Verifier-Gated Step-Level GRPO), a verifier-gated extension of GRPO that addresses these limitations with three design choices. First, VeriGate keeps the verifier in charge whenever verifier rewards induce a meaningful preference among sampled trajectories, and uses process supervision only when verifier rewards are degenerate. Second, instead of collapsing Process Reward Model (PRM) step scores into a single trajectory reward, VeriGate converts them into future-cumulated rewards to assign continuation-aware credit. Third, VeriGate transforms these rewards into group-normalized token-level advantages, restoring informative gradients and fine-grained credit assignment while remaining less susceptible to reward hacking than methods that optimize aggregated PRM scores. Empirically, training on MATH with 1.5B and 7B Qwen2.5-Instruct models and evaluating on six reasoning benchmarks, VeriGate improves average accuracy by about 20% and 12% for 1.5B and 7B models respectively, substantially reduces zero-gradient failures, decreases reward-hacking behavior, and improves reasoning quality relative to outcome-only GRPO and PRM-as-outcome baselines.

</details>


### [108] [DisjunctiveNet: Neural Symbolic Learning via Differentiable Convexified Optimization Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30456)
*Shraman Pal,Can Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DisjunctiveNet提出了一种统一的端到端框架，通过将逻辑规则表示为析取约束并利用层次凸松弛获得凸包公式，实现在神经网络中硬性强制执行输入依赖的混合整数线性约束，兼顾精确规则满足与端到端可微性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学和工程学习任务中数据稀疏，常需结合物理定律和专家启发式等先验知识。现有神经符号方法主要通过软惩罚近似满足规则，无法保证可行性；或仅支持输入无关规则；或在推理时依赖不可微的后处理。混合整数约束的内在非凸性使得将其嵌入可微优化层面临挑战。

Method: 将每条规则建模为析取约束（多面体集合的有限并），通过ℓ₁ epigraph重构将投影问题表述为线性规划。提出CNF（合取范式）和DNF（析取范式）两种凸松弛：CNF对每条规则独立凸化后求交（线性复杂度），DNF枚举所有规则间析取项的交集后取凸包（指数复杂度但精确），以及通过基本步（basic step）进行部分DNF的序列凸化。梯度通过KKT条件的隐式微分计算。证明了DNF松弛下的极值点满足原始逻辑约束（定理3.6）。

Result: 在合成冷却控制任务中，DNF投影层在IID和OOD测试集上均达到100%规则满足，显著优于软惩罚方法（OOD下CSAT极低）。在scRNA-seq细胞类型分类（PBMC3k）任务中，DNF达到约90.8%-94.8% CSAT，远超基线网络和惩罚方法。投影层在低数据量下显著提升性能（如n=12时DNF的CSAT为0.908 vs 基线0.105），但在充足数据下基线在F1上可能反超。计算开销：每样本推理约25-29ms，DNF在k=10时仍低于1秒。

Conclusion: 该框架是首个能在训练和推理期间对输入依赖的混合整数线性约束提供硬性可行性保证的端到端学习方法，统一了神经符号逻辑规则和MILP优化层的约束表达。投影层在低数据场景下同时提升预测性能和规则满足率，揭示了约束紧度与精度之间的原则性权衡。未来工作包括扩展凸非线性约束、自适应序列凸化启发式方法以及冲突规则处理机制。

Abstract: Many learning tasks in science and engineering are characterized by sparse datasets, which limits the effectiveness of purely data-driven approaches. At the same time, these problems are often accompanied by rich domain knowledge derived from physical laws, operational requirements, and expert heuristics. Such knowledge is frequently expressed as rules involving logical propositions and linear inequalities. Existing neuro-symbolic methods typically enforce these rules approximately through soft penalties, assume input-independent rules when designing specialized architectures, or rely on non-differentiable post-processing at inference time to achieve hard constraint satisfaction. While recent advances in differentiable optimization layers enable end-to-end feasibility enforcement within neural networks, extending these approaches to logical or mixed-integer rules remains challenging due to inherent nonconvexity. In this work, we propose a unified end-to-end framework for enforcing hard, input-dependent mixed integer linear constraints within neural networks. Our approach represents rules as disjunctive constraints and applies hierarchical convex relaxations to obtain convex hull formulations. These relaxations yield tractable linear constraints that can be embedded as differentiable optimization layers while enabling exact rule satisfaction. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework on real-world datasets, achieving perfect rule satisfaction and strong predictive performance.

</details>


### [109] [Can Subgraph Explanations Be Weaponized to Steal Graph Neural Networks?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30470)
*Ojas Nimase,Jiate Li,Yue Zhao,Yushun Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出XSTEAL，首个针对图分类GNN在严格黑盒约束（仅可观察离散类别标签和二元解释掩码）下的模型提取攻击。该方法将模型提取重新定义为边界对搜索问题，利用解释子图引导蒙特卡洛边敏感度估计来高效定位决策边界，在8个基准数据集、3种受害架构、2种解释器上均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着Graph ML即服务平台为满足监管透明度要求而提供可解释性接口，这种透明性反而成为模型提取攻击的可利用漏洞。现有GNN提取方法存在三大局限：(1)缺乏对有效训练数据的原则性理解；(2)连续域的边界搜索技术无法迁移到离散图空间；(3)现有方法需要概率分数/梯度等丰富信息，违反现实API部署中的最小信息披露原则。本文旨在回答一个关键问题：用于透明度的解释是否可以被武器化以窃取其所解释的模型？

Method: XSTEAL框架包含三个核心组件：(1)基于Hoeffding不等式的蒙特卡洛边敏感度估计——在仅能获得离散标签的情况下，通过随机扰动估计每条边对决策边界跨越的贡献，具有O(1/√n_e · log(1/δ))的浓度保证；(2)离散梯度引导的边界搜索——迭代选择Top-k最敏感边进行翻转直至跨越决策边界；(3)解释引导的查询约简——将候选边集从O(|V|²)缩减到O(|V_sub|²)，仅关注解释子图内/相邻边、携带边和随机探索边。算法采用两阶段设计：Phase 1穷尽单边移除测试，Phase 2对未找到边界的图执行解释引导的MC搜索。

Result: 在8个图分类基准（分子、生物、视觉、合成领域）上，XSTEAL的Boundary和Hybrid变体在所有数据集-解释器组合上均获得最高保真度。关键结果包括：Tox21数据集上保真度从60.7%提升至92.9%（+32.2点），MUTAG达到100.0% vs 81.8%，PTC_FM为90.5% vs 77.4%。方法在GCN/GAT/GraphSAGE三种架构及GNNExplainer/PGExplainer两种解释器上均表现稳健。消融实验显示：Phase 2比Phase 1提升7.5点保真度，MC采样贡献约4.9点。多类分类场景下性能有所下降（如MNIST 55.1%、Synthie 51.3%），这与边界对需在C(C,2)对决策面间分散有关。

Conclusion: 本文证实子图解释确实可被武器化以窃取GNN。将模型提取重构为边界对搜索问题，并在严格黑盒约束下开发了首个面向图分类的解释引导提取攻击。蒙特卡洛边敏感度估计结合Hoeffding浓度保证，使搜索仅在解释相关子图区域进行。这些发现揭示了模型透明性监管要求与GNN服务安全之间的根本矛盾——即使在最小信息披露的离散输出设置下，解释接口仍暴露决策边界信息，亟需发展在提供有意义解释的同时不泄露决策边界的防御机制。

Abstract: Graph Machine Learning as a Service (GMLaaS) platforms increasingly implement explainability interfaces to meet regulatory transparency requirements. However, this transparency creates exploitable vulnerabilities for model extraction attacks. We present the first model extraction attack specifically designed for graph classification under strict black-box constraints where the attacker observes only discrete class labels and binary explanation masks (no probability scores, gradients, or confidence values). Our method (1) uses model explanation outputs to guide Monte Carlo edge sensitivity estimation toward decision boundaries, with Hoeffding concentration guarantees on estimation accuracy and (2) exploits explanation subgraphs to efficiently narrow the boundary search space. Extensive experiments on benchmark graph datasets across multiple domains demonstrate our method's superiority over comparable baselines. These findings demonstrate that such explainability interfaces create exploitable attack surfaces, informing both defensive mechanisms and policy frameworks for explainable AI mandates. The implementation code is provided in this https URL .

</details>


### [110] [Universal Multiclass Transductive Online Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30479)
*Steve Hanneke,Hongao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了通用多类转导式在线学习（Universal Multiclass Transductive Online Learning）问题，其中标签空间可以是可数无穷的。作者刻画了该设置下概念类的可学习性，证明了可学习类仅存在两种最优速率：有界常数或对数增长，并引入了一种新的组合结构"Level-Constrained-Littlestone-Littlestone (LCLL) 树"，结合"无差异性（indifferent property）"来刻画可学习性。此外，作者将结果扩展到不可知（agnostic）情形以及仅知生成实例序列的随机过程的情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线学习框架中，学习者需要同时面对与标签相关和与实例相关的不确定性。Ben-David等人(1997)引入了离线/转导式在线学习模型来消除实例相关的不确定性。Hanneke等人(2023b)将其重新命名为转导式在线学习。Hanneke和Wang(2024)进一步研究了乐观通用在线学习。然而，之前的工作主要集中在二分类和均匀学习速率（与序列无关），本文旨在研究通用（序列相关）学习速率下的多类转导式在线学习，其中标签空间是无界的。核心动机是：什么组合结构能正确刻画无界标签空间下多类转导式在线学习的可学习性？

Method: 1. 提出新组合结构LCLL树（Level-Constrained-Littlestone-Littlestone树），它是Littlestone树与LCL树的结合，每个深度k的节点标记为k+1个实例组成的序列，每个节点有2^{k+1}个子节点。2. 定义"无差异性(indifferent property)"，即BFS序中后继节点的所有后代函数在前驱节点上取值一致。3. 构造LCLL博弈和Littlestone博弈，利用Borel确定性定理证明：当概念类无无限无差异LCLL树时，博弈者P_B有必胜策略。4. 设计基于权函数的转导式在线学习算法（Algorithm 1, 2, 3），利用势函数/权重函数确保每次犯错时权重减半。5. 不可知情形下，构造专家集合（Algorithm 4），结合Koolen和van Erven(2015)的Squint算法和非均匀初始权重进行学习。6. 随机过程情形下，修改预测规则为概率预测（Algorithm 5, 6），利用Azuma不等式和Borel-Cantelli引理证明o(T)遗憾界。7. 关键技术贡献：设计了一种新型Gale-Stewart博弈，其中对手需要为实例区间提供所有可能的标签序列而非单一标签序列。

Result: 主要结果（定理2.8和2.9）：
1. **可实现情形的三分法**：
   - 若ℋ无无限无差异Littlestone树，则存在算法使错误数M = O(1)
   - 若ℋ有无限无差异Littlestone树但无无限无差异LCLL树，则最优速率为Θ(log T)
   - 若ℋ有无限无差异LCLL树，则任何学习者都无法保证次线性错误数
2. **不可知情形**：ℋ是可通用转导式在线学习的，当且仅当ℋ无无限无差异LCLL树，且遗憾界为Õ(√T)
3. **随机过程情形**（定理D.6）：所有过程都允许通用在线学习，当且仅当ℋ无无限LCLL树
4. **下界**（引理5.2）：遗憾下界为Ω(√T)，通过Khinchine不等式和Azuma不等式证明

作者还提供了反例（Example 3.1和3.3），表明DSL树和LCL树等自然候选结构均非正确答案。

Conclusion: 本文完整刻画了无界标签空间下多类通用转导式在线学习的可学习性。核心贡献是引入LCLL树结合无差异性作为正确的组合刻画，并发现最优学习速率仅有两类：常数或有界对数增长。技术亮点是设计了一种新型Gale-Stewart博弈框架来处理无差异树结构，该方法可能适用于其他刻画涉及无差异Littlestone类树的多类在线学习问题。未来的开放问题包括：(1) 缩小不可知情形下遗憾上下界之间的多项式对数差距；(2) 刻画无界标签空间下过程允许通用在线学习的充要条件；(3) 将结果推广到bandit反馈、实值函数回归等其他设置。

Abstract: We consider the problem of universal transductive online classification with a possibly unbounded label space. This setting considers online learning, with the sequence of instances (without labels) known to the learner in advance. We say a concept class $\mathcal{H}$ is learnable if there is a learning algorithm $\mathcal{A}$, such that for every realizable sequence, the number of mistakes made by $\mathcal{A}$ grows at most sublinearly with the number of predictions. We characterize the learnability of this setting and show that there are only two possible optimal rates for the learnable classes: either bounded or increasing logarithmically. We introduce a new combinatorial structure, called ``Level-Constrained-Littlestone-Littlestone (LCLL) tree'', which, along with the indifference property, characterizes the learnability. We also extend the learnability result to the agnostic case and the case where only the stochastic process that generates the instance sequence is known.

</details>


### [111] [Discovering a Zeta Map Algorithm on Dyck Paths via Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30482)
*Xiaoyu Huang,Blake Jackson,Kyu-Hwan Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文以Dyck路径上的zeta映射为测试用例,展示了一种AI辅助数学发现的工作流程:训练一个极简的一层一头的encoder-decoder transformer,通过机制可解释性工具(交叉注意力分析、线性探针、因果消融)提取模型学到的"基于层级(level-based)"计算机制,并将其翻译为一种新的显式组合算法——"scaffolding map"(支架映射)。作者严格证明该算法与zeta映射等价(仅差一个标签反转约定),从而提供了一个受控的、模型行为可被独立验证的AI辅助数学发现案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前机器学习在数学中的应用多将模型视作高精度预测器或生成器,但数学发现真正需要的是可被人独立验证的显式构造(猜想、构造、算法)。本文以q,t-Catalan数理论中经典的zeta映射(将(dinv, area)统计量与(area, bounce)统计量互换的双射)为具体测试场景,研究能否从一个训练好的小型transformer中通过机制可解释性方法"反向工程"出一个新的、可形式化证明的组合算法。

Method: 1. 在n=11到16的多个Catalan规模数据集上训练encoder-decoder transformer预测zeta映射,均达到>99%准确率。2. 压缩模型为"Minimal Dyck Transformer":d_model=128,1层encoder、1层decoder、1个注意力头,约3.66×10^5参数,在n=13上训练并达到近乎完美准确率。3. 对该极小模型进行机制可解释性分析:(a) 动态追踪decoder交叉注意力权重,识别出三种反复出现的模式——最高层级选择、对w_i=1位置的回避、三角形顺序移动;(b) 对w_i=1位置进行因果消融,准确率几乎不下降;(c) 在encoder隐状态上训练线性探针恢复层级值ℓ_i,准确率达84%。4. 将上述信号翻译为组合语言,得到peak-centered的traversal算法"scaffolding map",该算法按层级自顶向下从peak位置释放agent进行遍历,输出对应Dyck路径。5. 给出完整的组合证明:通过定义位置i到面积序列a_r的关联及b_i指标,证明在每一层k上,算法生成的队列Q'_k恰等于rev∘ζ算法产生的子序列P_k,从而φ=rev∘ζ。

Result: 1. 极小的1层1头encoder-decoder transformer能够以近乎完美的准确率学习zeta映射。2. 机制分析揭示模型学到的不是任意查找表,而是层级化的计算:encoder隐状态使层级信息线性可访问(线性探针84%准确率),decoder通过交叉注意力按层级选择和遍历输入位置,且几乎不直接关注向上步位置。3. 从模型行为中提炼出scaffolding map——一种以peak为中心的显式层级遍历算法,统一定义于任意半长度n的Dyck路径。4. 严格证明该算法与zeta映射等价(φ=rev∘ζ,差一个标签反转约定),为AI辅助数学发现提供了可被独立验证的定理。

Conclusion: 本文展示了机制可解释性可将神经模型行为转化为可独立验证的数学对象的工作流程:模型提供反复出现的结构信号,研究者将其解读为组合操作,因果干预验证解释的因果相关性,最终得到的程序成为可陈述、可证明的数学定理。研究表明,即使是一个被刻意压缩到极小规模(1层1头)的transformer,其内部结构也包含足够的组合信息来启发新的算法发现。局限在于:注意力模式本身不是机制的证明(需配合因果消融与探针);模型实现的是scaffolding算法的"模糊"版本;小模型在不同随机种子下可能学得不同的内部解。未来方向包括自动化电路发现、可解释性agent与定理证明器的结合,以及将此类方法推广到更大、更不透明的模型。

Abstract: Machine learning is increasingly used in mathematical discovery, but in mathematics the desired output is often not a prediction itself, but an explicit construction that can be checked independently. We study this setting through the zeta map on Dyck paths, a classical bijection in the combinatorics of the q,t-Catalan numbers. We train a deliberately small one-layer, one-head encoder-decoder transformer on this map and analyze its learned computation using mechanistic interpretability tools, including decoder cross-attention analysis, linear probing, and causal intervention. The analysis reveals a level-based mechanism: encoder representations make path levels linearly accessible, while the decoder selects and traverses input positions in a structured way. Translating these signals into combinatorics leads to the scaffolding map, an explicit peak-centered traversal algorithm for Dyck paths. We prove that this algorithm agrees with the zeta map, modulo a reversal convention in the labeling. This gives a controlled example of AI-assisted mathematical discovery in which mechanistic interpretability turns model behavior into a precise, human-verifiable combinatorial algorithm.

</details>


### [112] [MAAT: Multi-phase Adapter-Aware Targeted Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30514)
*Suryash Yagnik,Shubham Gaur,Saksham Thakur,Vinija Jain,Aman Chadha,Amitava Das*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对机器遗忘(machine unlearning)评估中因果/关系性知识(Why型问题)被系统性低估的结构性盲区，提出了5WBench基准和MAAT三阶段遗忘框架。5WBench提供5,000个均衡覆盖5W类别(Who/What/When/Where/Why)的样本，MAAT通过LoRA适配器上的梯度投影正交化、SVD秩维度剪枝、任务向量取反和混合KL-隐状态保留修复四个组件，首次在Why型因果知识上同时实现高遗忘率与高保留率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遗忘评估基准(CounterFact、ZSRE、TOFU、MUSE、WMDP-Cyber)严重偏向实体中心的事实型问题，Why型因果问题占比极低(0.06%~1.3%)，导致在因果知识上失败的遗忘方法仍能获得较高聚合分数，且该失败无法被检测到。作者旨在揭示并量化这一评估盲区，并提出首个在因果知识遗忘上同时实现高遗忘与高保留的方法。

Method: 1) **5WBench基准**：从Factify-5WQA构建，5W类别各1,000样本(共5,000)，每类各500遗忘+500保留；2) **MAAT三阶段框架**（仅操作LoRA适配器权重，不合并入基模型）—— Phase 1: 条件正交梯度投影上升（仅当遗忘梯度与保留梯度冲突时正交化）；Phase 2a: MLP适配器模块(down/up/gate_proj)的SVD秩维度剪枝（基于遗忘集梯度列范数评分，剪掉top-ρ维度，排除注意力模块）；Phase 2b: 对top-k_F遗忘评分秩维度进行任务向量取反；Phase 3: 混合保留修复目标（KL散度+隐状态表示距离+遗忘集熵最大化+任务向量余弦惩罚，熵项取负号以阻止遗忘内容被重新学回）。

Result: 在LLaMA 3.2-3B上，MAAT取得77.4% FSR / 71.6% RSR（均衡平均），是唯一在所有5W类别上同时超过60% FSR和60% RSR的方法（Why型：63%/65%）。在Gemma 3-4B上取得64.0%/61.8%。相比RO-FT在LLaMA上同为77.4% FSR但RSR仅35.2%，MAAT实现了+36.4点的保留提升。Adapter Negation基线虽达99.8% FSR但RSR崩塌至0.4%，验证了完整任务向量取反不加区分地删除遗忘与保留知识。TOFU上MAAT亦达最佳平衡（67.5%/46.6%）。消融实验验证各阶段贡献：注意力剪枝虽能提升遗忘但严重损害保留(54% RSR)，故最终设计中排除；任务向量取反是平衡遗忘-保留权衡的关键组件。Why型困难源于平均40.1 token的长答案跨度（其他类型4.2–10.5）和44%的多跳推理链（其他≤2%），编码分析证实所有5W类别共享均匀分布式编码，难度源自关系复杂度与梯度稀释而非独特编码特征。

Conclusion: 5WBench通过均衡5W分类法首次使因果遗忘失败可被量化；MAAT是首个在Why型因果知识上同时实现高遗忘与高保留的方法，确立了遗忘-保留Pareto前沿上的新操作点。LLaMA 3.2-3B（77.4/71.6）与Gemma 3-4B（64.0/61.8）的性能差异表明适配器秩可分性具有架构依赖性，架构感知的适配器秩选择是未来重要方向。5WBench的格式与均衡5W覆盖也可直接应用于模型编辑评估（包括因果知识的插入与修改）。局限包括：单一Qwen 2.5-7B LLM评判、Factify-5WQA派生数据可能含主体提取噪声、仅评估3–4B规模两个模型族、仅评估遗忘操作而未涉及插入/修改。

Abstract: Machine unlearning evaluation is structurally skewed: Why-type questions, which probe causal and relational knowledge, comprise less than 0.06% of CounterFact, 0.6% of ZSRE, and less than 1.3% of TOFU, MUSE, and WMDP-Cyber. This near-zero representation means that methods that fail on causal knowledge can score highly in aggregate, and this failure is undetectable without balanced evaluation. We present 5WBENCH, a balanced 5,000-sample benchmark with 1,000 examples per 5W category (Who, What, When, Where, Why), making causal unlearning failures quantifiable for the first time. Using 5WBENCH, we show that no existing baseline simultaneously achieves high forgetting and high retention on Why-type questions: aggressive forgetting degrades retained knowledge, while conservative methods fail to forget causal facts. Why-type difficulty stems from multi-hop reasoning chains (44% of Why entries vs. less than or equal to 2% for others) and gradient dilution over 40.1-token answer spans. We present MAAT (Multi-phase Adapter-Aware Targeted Unlearning), a three-phase framework operating on LoRA adapter weights, combining gradient-projected ascent, SVD rank-dimension pruning, task vector negation, and hybrid KL-hidden-state retain repair. MAAT is the first method to simultaneously achieve high forgetting and high retention on Why-type causal knowledge, reaching a new operating point on the forget-retain Pareto frontier. We make our code publicly available.

</details>


### [113] [Representation Collapse in Sequential Post-Training of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30524)
*Yichen Liu,Mingyu Chen,Hao Wang,Xiaoran Xu,Chenxi Lin,Rui Zhang,Yutong Zhou,Yuxin Yang,Jiarui Wu,Wei Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究大语言模型在多阶段顺序后训练（如SFT、偏好优化、安全对齐、数学/代码专业化、长链思维微调）过程中是否会导致内部表征坍缩（representation collapse），即隐藏状态趋向低秩、各向异性和同质化。作者提出了一套分层级的诊断指标体系，并通过控制实验证明这种几何上的集中化会预测后续学习能力的下降（可塑性降低），同时评估了几种轻量级干预方法（混合域回放、特征刷新、表征多样性正则化、LoRA更新去相关）以缓解该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大语言模型的后训练通常由多个连续阶段组成（指令微调、偏好优化、安全对齐、领域专业化等），现有评估主要关注行为层面的最终性能（如指令跟随、基准测试得分），而忽略了训练过程中模型内部特征空间几何结构的变化。这种"行为增益-几何退化"的不对称性可能导致一个静默的失败模式：模型在当前任务上表现更好，但对未来进一步适应变得困难。作者将持续学习中关于可塑性的经典担忧引入到LLM后训练场景，系统性地研究表征坍缩问题。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) **测量套件**：包括隐藏状态的谱分析（有效秩、参与比、top-k方差）、几何度量（中心化/非中心化各向异性、CKA漂移）、token动态（不同生成区段的秩）、函数空间度量（logit熵、top-k间隔、词汇支持度、ECE）以及LoRA更新子空间重叠度量；(2) **控制实验设计**：使用1B-7B开源模型（Qwen2.5、TinyLlama、Llama-3.2、OLMo、Mistral），构建四种顺序后训练序列（A：专业化链；B：推理与偏好；C：安全优先；D：路径依赖），在固定探针语料上跨阶段追踪表征变化；(3) **理论分析**：基于线性化模型推导谱坍缩与未来可塑性的形式化联系，并在未来任务上进行固定预算适应实验以验证预测性。

Result: 主要实验结果显示：(1) 顺序后训练是**轨迹式坍缩**而非一次性现象，中间和后部Transformer层坍缩最严重；(2) 坍缩具有**目标依赖性**——安全/拒绝微调产生强响应模板方向和更锐利的logit，长CoT微调创建推理格式方向，偏好优化放大各向异性，数学/代码微调表现更复杂；(3) **坍缩预测未来学习**：如表4所示，目标分数单调提升（54.2→70.1），但有效秩持续下降（0.74→0.58），未来任务适应分数也持续下降（71.0→60.7），暴露了即时行为增益与长期可塑性之间的差距；(4) 干预方法可改善Pareto前沿：混合域回放、特征刷新、表征多样性正则化、LoRA更新去相关均能在保持目标域性能的同时提升未来学习能力。

Conclusion: 该研究将后训练重新框定为持续学习问题，提出了一套实用的诊断工具，帮助实践者区分有益的专业化与脆性的窄化。核心结论是：过度表征集中不仅是几何好奇心，而是后续适应困难的可预测信号。作者强调坍缩应作为后训练流程中的常规诊断指标与验证损失、偏好胜率等并用。论文承认存在规模限制（仅1B-7B模型）、测量依赖性（探针语料、token区间、中心化惯例的影响）以及因果解释的局限（相关性不等于因果，干预证据是关键）。总体而言，论文为"顺序后训练是否损害未来可塑性"这一关键问题提供了系统的实证基础和实用工具。

Abstract: Large language models are now adapted through chains of post-training stages rather than through a single instruction-tuning pass. This paper studies whether such sequential post-training gradually compresses internal representations into low-rank, anisotropic, and homogeneous feature spaces. We define a measurement suite for hidden states, logits, token trajectories, and LoRA updates, and we use it to analyze supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, safety/refusal tuning, math and code specialization, and long chain-of-thought tuning under controlled stage orderings. The central hypothesis is that excessive representation concentration is not merely a geometric curiosity: it predicts reduced plasticity during later adaptation, weaker out-of-domain generalization, and poorer calibration. We further evaluate lightweight interventions, including mixed-domain replay, feature refresh, representation diversity regularization, and LoRA update decorrelation, as ways to preserve future learnability without giving up the behavioral gains of post-training.

</details>


### [114] [Measuring, Localizing, and Ablating Alignment Signatures in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30526)
*Aniket Anand,Janvijay Singh,Zhewei Sun,Dilek Hakkani-Tür,Nick Feamster*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究对齐语言模型中可识别的"AI风格"是否源自后训练，并提出了一种无需训练的无干预方法 PASTA（Post-training Alignment Signature Targeted Ablation），通过估计并消融对齐模型与基模型之间的残差流方向来降低AI文本检测率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对齐语言模型普遍表现出明显的"AI风格"（如润色的措辞、对冲性表达、结构化输出），但这种风格是否由后训练引入或放大，以及是否在模型内部表征中可定位，尚不清楚。先前工作主要从行为层面（输出层面）表征后训练效果，缺乏对内部表征的机制性理解。

Method: 1. **表面签名测量（Section 3）**：通过匹配人类写作前缀构建 (t_human, t_base, t_aligned) 三元组，在5个领域（科学摘要、创意小说、评论、大学作文、新闻）和11个基/对齐模型对上，用 infini-gram 计算 RedPajama+ 语料库的 overlap density 和 Coverage@10，并使用6个AI检测器（Pangram、GPTZero、Binoculars、ImBD、RAIDAR 等）评估检测率。 2. **PASTA 方法（Section 4）**：对每个对齐模型和基模型，在校准集上对生成token的残差流激活取均值，再对层 ℓ 计算归一化的对齐-基差方向 v_PASTA^ℓ = (μ_align^ℓ - μ_base^ℓ)/‖·‖₂。检测器引导的层扫描选择最有效的层 ℓ*，然后在推理时通过前/后钩子从残差流中投影出该方向。 3. **特异性、质量与鲁棒性分析（Section 5）**：通过随机方向对照实验、LLM 评判（Claude Sonnet 4.6）的成对相关性/流畅性比较、消融强度扫描、域特异方向、检测器特定方向提取等验证 PASTA 的有效性与局限性。

Result: **H1（语料库亲和性）**：在所有5个领域，语料库亲和性一致遵循 Human > Base > Aligned 顺序。**H2（检测器可见性）**：对齐生成的AI检测率显著高于基模型（Pangram：98.5% vs 9.2%；GPTZero：84.5% vs 2.9%）。**PASTA 效果**：在11个对齐模型中，8个在 Pangram 上下降 73.2–98.0 个百分点，ImBD 和 RAIDAR 在所有模型上都下降，Binoculars 在10/11模型上下降；效果可跨检测器迁移。**随机方向对照**：22/24 模型-检测器对中 PASTA 优于随机方向。**质量**：PASTA 保持大幅优于基模型的相关性和流畅性（WR=0.954 相关性、WR=0.663 流畅性），仅略低于对齐模型。**鲁棒性**：域无关方向与域特定方向效果相当；消融强度存在检测率-质量权衡前沿；SFT 阶段引入最强的检测器可见签名。

Conclusion: 后训练在残差流中留下了可测量的、可定位的"对齐签名"方向，AI风格不仅是一个输出层面的模式。PASTA 表明这一签名可被无训练地估计、消融并因果检验，为理解后训练如何塑造生成风格提供了机制性工具，并提示未来后训练方法应在保持帮助性和安全性的同时避免将生成过度压缩为窄化、单一可识别的风格。

Abstract: Aligned language models often exhibit a recognizable AI-like style, yet its connection to post-training and internal representations remains poorly understood. In this work, we study whether post-training introduces or amplifies AI-like stylistic regularities and whether these regularities have a localized internal signature. To this end, we compare human text, base-model generations, and aligned-model generations under matched human-source prefixes. Aligned generations show lower human-corpus affinity and higher AI-detection rates than base generations, suggesting that post-training shifts generated text away from human-corpus style and toward detector-visible AI-like text. We then introduce PASTA (Post-training Alignment Signature Targeted Ablation), a training-free method that estimates a post-training alignment signature from aligned-base residual contrasts and ablates the corresponding direction during decoding. Across 11 aligned models and 6 AI detectors, PASTA lowers the detection rate for most aligned models; this effect transfers well across detectors and is not reproduced by random directions. Qualitative analysis suggests that PASTA generations remain relevant and coherent while exhibiting greater stylistic variation. Together, these results show that AI-like stylistic effects of post-training can be measured, localized, and causally tested through activation ablation.

</details>


### [115] [The Long-Term Effects of Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30537)
*Yuxin Yang,Aoxiong Zeng,Xiangquan Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LLM多阶段微调中数据选择的"长期视角"，揭示了当前阶段最优的选择策略可能损害未来适应能力（"短视选择"现象），并提出Long-Horizon Aware Selection（LHAS）诊断性基线，在统一多阶段协议下比较六大类选择器，证明梯度/损失选择在当前表现最佳但未来适应最差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据选择方法（基于质量、影响、效用-多样性等）仅在单阶段微调下评估其即时效用，忽视了现代LLM适配是顺序进行的（通用指令→数学→代码→安全→领域语料）。当前阶段的最优子集不仅节省算力，还改变了后续阶段训练的参数起点，可能使表征、梯度和适配器偏向狭窄能力集，降低未来可学习性与鲁棒性。作者将这种"最大化即时效用而牺牲未来适应/保留/OOD鲁棒性"的现象形式化为"短视选择"（myopic selection）。

Method: 1) 形式化长期选择问题：定义长期目标函数U_long，包含未来适应AUC、遗忘F_t、OOD鲁棒性R_ood等；定义"短视差距"（myopia gap）量化即时与长期评估下选择器排序的不一致。2) 轨迹诊断：能力熵、更新集中度（最大特征值占比）、适配器漂移。3) 理论分析：在损失局部二次近似下，证明两个选择器可具有相同当前改进但因更新方向在未来任务Hessian加权梯度上投影不同而导致不同未来损失（Proposition 1）。4) 比较六类选择器（随机/损失/梯度/多样性/质量/效用-多样性）与提出的LHAS（u+λ·覆盖+η·未来代理对齐−ρ·反集中）。5) 协议：8B级开源LLM+LoRA(rank=16)，三种任务序列（技能、领域、交错），25%选择预算，报告当前分、未来AUC、遗忘、OOD、最差任务与短视差距。

Result: 技能序列25%预算下的关键结果：梯度选择当前分最高(62.4)但未来AUC最低(0.52)、遗忘最高(9.4)、短视差距最大(0.47)；损失选择类似(当前61.9, 遗忘8.6)。随机和多样性当前分较低但长期表现稳健。LHAS以略低的当前分(61.4 vs 62.4)换取最优长期组合：未来AUC 0.67、遗忘3.9、OOD 58.2、最差任务53.1、短视差距0.10。梯度选择达到下一阶段相同早期验证阈值需比LHAS多约1.35×选中token。预算消融（10%/25%/50%）显示长期排名稳定，大预算仅降低方差而不消除效应。任务顺序消融表明未来阶段与当前任务弱对齐时短视效应最强。LoRA设定下效应更显著（全参数微调减弱但不消除）。诊断显示损失/梯度选择能力熵低(1.22-1.28)、更新集中度高(0.58-0.63)，证实机制为梯度协方差窄化。

Conclusion: 在线数据选择应被视为塑造模型学习轨迹的长期训练干预，而非局部数据效率机制。论文提出双层评分卡建议：常规层（当前分、预算、稳定性）+长期层（未来AUC、遗忘、最差任务、OOD、更新集中度）。实践上，LHAS并非要替代现有选择器，而是倡导对损失/质量类选择器进行长期审计，必要时加入覆盖约束、replay混合或未来代理惩罚。局限性：任务序列风格化、未来代理混合需预先指定、质量选择依赖带偏见的奖励模型/评判器、结论限于SFT+LoRA，未涵盖RLHF/预训练/智能体场景。

Abstract: Data selection is increasingly used to reduce the cost of large language model (LLM) fine-tuning, with recent methods prioritizing samples by current utility, diversity, quality, or influence. This paper studies a different question: when fine-tuning occurs over multiple stages, can selection strategies that look optimal now make the model less adaptable later? We introduce a long-horizon view of LLM data selection in which a selector is evaluated not only by immediate task performance, but also by future adaptation speed, forgetting, capability imbalance, and out-of-distribution robustness. We compare representative random, loss-based, gradient-based, diversity-based, quality-based, and utility-diversity selection families under a unified multi-stage protocol. Through controlled experiments designed to instantiate this protocol, we show how short-term selectors can exhibit rank reversal: they improve the current stage while slowing subsequent learning and increasing forgetting. We formalize this behavior as \emph{myopic selection}, provide a simple local analysis of why it can occur, and propose a diagnostic Long-Horizon Aware Selection (LHAS) objective that augments immediate utility with coverage, future-proxy transfer, and anti-concentration terms. The study argues that data selection should be evaluated as a training intervention that shapes the model's learning trajectory, rather than only as a local data-efficiency mechanism.

</details>


### [116] [DisasterLex: An Expert Concept-to-Schema Knowledge Graph for Geospatial Reasoning in Disaster Analytics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30538)
*Yiming Xiao,Ankit Basu,Kai Yin,Sahil Vartak,Christian Swords,Ali Mostafavi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DisasterLex是一个面向灾害分析的结构化表格问答框架，通过在用户查询和数据库之间插入专家策划的知识图谱（EKG，含107个概念、117条类型化因果边和52个概念到表的桥接边），将模式上下文从150列压缩到10-20列，并在36表灾害数据库上以四阶段编排管道（上下文提取→ICS集群路由→因果规划→工具增强执行）实现跨7个基础模型（Gemini、DeepSeek、Qwen、Llama等）的一致性SOTA，75用例测试集上以1.4-2.75倍优势超越LightRAG、HippoRAG 2、ReFoRCE和CHESS四个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾害应急决策依赖结构化地理空间表格（危害、暴露度、脆弱性、生命线基础设施），但现有方法存在三方面不足：(1) text-to-SQL方法在150列异构模式上注意力稀释，产生幻觉连接；(2) 通用RAG检索文本段落而非生成可执行SQL；(3) 现有图增强RAG和schema-linking方法无法编码领域因果结构（如不透水面→径流→洪水发生），导致基线失败集中在路由错误和跨多表SQL组合上。

Method: 框架包含三个核心组件：(1) **统一知识图谱**（Neo4j）——DDCG自动内省自DuckDB（36表、150列，H3 resolution-8六边形网格），EKG手工策划含8类概念节点和Increases/Reduces/Indicates/Requires/Scales五种类型化因果边，52个Maps_To边桥接概念与表；(2) **概念感知模式检索**——同义词正则匹配激活EKG概念→Cypher遍历取表→注入紧凑模式块（典型10-20列）；(3) **四阶段LangGraph编排**——Stage1上下文与关键性提取（1-5级，≥3级门控高关键性建议）+ 数据可用性检查；Stage2 ICS驱动的三集群路由（生命安全行动/损害评估响应/基础设施缓解）；Stage3 ReAct因果规划器（KG+web搜索，2次KG调用预算）；Stage4 ReAct执行器（text-to-SQL工具含语法校验+DuckDB只读执行+3次重试，KG工具1-3跳遍历）。在德州灾害分析数据库上实例化，使用FEMA NRI、Census、CDC SVI、HIFLD等公共联邦数据源。

Result: 在75用例四级诊断基准（R路由17题+K EKG接地19题+M多表组合26题+D数据可用性披露13题）上：完整管道在7个基础模型上总体得分1.65-3.56（满分5.0），比4个SOTA外部基线高1.4-2.75倍（50/56对比差距在95%置信区间显著，168/224分层级差距在p<0.05显著）；路由组件在所有模型上均为关键负载（消融后Tier M下降0.81-2.67），规划与EKG效果因模型异质性大（Qwen 3.6 Flash对No Plan敏感度最高-2.12，DeepSeek V3.2最耐受-0.17）；4个开源模型（Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen3 8B/32B、Llama 3.3 70B）因天花板较低跌幅较小。错误分析显示基线失败集中在路由和跨多表SQL组合（系统编排明确针对的操作）。Tier M仍为最弱层级，主要失败模式为部分模式选择、连接键错误、聚合漂移和容差带未命中。

Conclusion: DisasterLex通过将专家策划的概念到模式桥接层与领域功能结构驱动的四阶段编排相结合，证明在灾害分析的结构化表格QA中，概念-模式中间层与编排设计的重要性超过检索基底或text-to-SQL智能体的选择；该模式可推广至其他专家因果知识与时间敏感结构化数据并存的领域（医疗分诊、供应链中断、基础设施事件响应），下一步将开展跨领域迁移研究。当前局限包括：仅支持结构化表格和英语、Texas地理范围限制、单一标注者的声明提取验证、未涵盖多模态（卫星图像、传感器、社交媒体）。

Abstract: Disasters are inevitable and increasingly costly, and effective response depends on querying structured tabular data: precise, information-dense records of hazard, exposure, vulnerability, and lifeline infrastructure that underpin disaster management. Current text-to-SQL methods enable natural-language access to such tables but transfer poorly to the disaster domain, where queries span heterogeneous geospatial schemas and require reasoning over causal relations. We introduce DisasterLex, a knowledge-graph-mediated framework that inserts an Expert Knowledge Graph (EKG) of curated concepts and typed causal edges between the user query and the database, bridged to schema by concept-to-table links. The orchestration runs four stages (identifying query entities, routing to the operational domain, planning over causal edges, and grounding the SQL), restricting the schema passed to the model at each step. We instantiate it on a disaster-analytics database (36 geospatial tables, 150 columns) with an EKG of 107 concepts, 117 causal edges, and 52 concept-to-schema links, evaluated on a 75-query test set. On all seven base models spanning proprietary and open-weight families, DisasterLex beats four state-of-the-art baselines (LightRAG, HippoRAG 2, ReFoRCE, CHESS) by 1.4x to 2.75x, with absolute scores of 1.65 to 3.56 (of 5.0). Error analysis shows baseline failures cluster in routing and multi-table SQL composition, the operations our orchestration explicitly addresses. Code, data, and the EKG artifact are available at this https URL and on Zenodo at this https URL .

</details>


### [117] [SubsurfaceGen: Procedural Generation of Field-Scale Earth Models and Seismic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30541)
*Joseph Stitt,Pratik Rathore,Madeleine Udell,Ching-Yao Lai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SubsurfaceGen——一个基于 GPU 加速的 3D 速度模型与地震数据程序化生成器，并发布了一个包含 42 个田级 3D 速度模型（10 km×10 km×6.19 km，10 m 分辨率）的配套数据集（4,276 个 2D 切片，配对 5 s 波场和 8 s 炮集），覆盖 6 种地质场景，用于支持基于机器学习的全波形反演（FWI）研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习驱动的 FWI 需要田级规模（field-scale）、地质多样、物理真实且可扩展的训练数据，但现有资源（Marmousi、SEAM、OpenFWI）至少在以下一个维度存在不足：空间范围有限（多数仅 0.7 km×0.7 km）、时间范围短（多在 1 s 以内）、地质多样性不足（缺少盐体、碳酸盐台地、斜坡沉积等关键构造）或物理真实性差（存在明显伪影）。这一数据瓶颈制约了 ML-FWI 的泛化能力、尺度行为和分布偏移鲁棒性研究。

Method: （1）速度模型生成器：基于 PyTorch 的 8 个模块化算子（Deposit、Squish、Fault、SaltSDT、SaltWedge、CarbonatePlatform、DeltaClinoformDeposit、StructuralSmoother），从基底到地表按地层年代顺序逐层叠加；后三者为本工作原创，Deposit/Squish/Fault 基于 Clapp 已有工作改进。（2）地震数据生成：基于 Devito 求解 2D 声波方程（8 阶空间有限差分，1 ms 时间步长，CFL 稳定），采用 Ricker 子波，5 个频带，顶部自由边界 + 三侧 60 层 Cerjan 海绵吸收层；单源 5 s 波场模拟与 64 源/1000 接收器 8 s 炮集模拟均在 GPU 加速。（3）数据集：42 个田级 3D 模型分为 6 种地质场景（Penobscot、F3、Gulf of Mexico、Fault、Salt Canopy、SEAM），共抽取 4,276 个 2D 切片，按 4,096/100/80 划分为训练/同分布测试/分布外（OOD）测试集（Penobscot 完全保留）。（4）实验任务：波场预测（TFNO、DPOT、TFNO-interp 三种神经算子的分块自回归 rollout）与端到端速度反演（InversionNet、Transformer、CNN 三种编解码架构的对比）。

Result: （1）速度模型构建的 GPU 加速：相比 16 核 CPU 实现 7.2×–26.8× 加速比，GPU 构建时间从 1–2 小时降至 5–10 分钟；其中 Fault 模块（38.9×）和 StructuralSmoother（34.5×）加速比最大，但 SaltSDT/SaltWedge 无明显 GPU 优势。（2）波场预测：田级网格（619×1000）超出单次前向传播显存预算，必须采用分块自回归（10 帧输入 → 50 帧输出，7 块链式生成）；在长程 rollout 中前向算子 L2RE 随时间复合增长约一个量级；基于最优检查点策略改进的 TFNO-interp 在锚点间间隙内 L2RE 比前向算子低约 6×。（3）端到端反演：CNN 架构因 3D 表征和编解码器残差结构在 RMSE/SSIM 上全面优于 InversionNet 和 Transformer；在 OOD（Penobscot）测试中 Transformer 的 SSIM 保持稳定，而 CNN 和 InversionNet 下降 0.04–0.07，揭示了架构与 OOD 泛化能力的关系。（4）频谱分析：TFNO-interp 在全频段占优，DPOT 在高频段优于 TFNO；GoM 与 Salt Canopy 因富含盐体成为最困难场景。

Conclusion: SubsurfaceGen 通过开源、GPU 加速的程序化生成管线，填补了田级、地质多样、物理真实、可扩展的 FWI 训练数据空白，降低了 ML 地震成像研究的准入门槛。其田级数据规模暴露了分块自回归误差复合的失效模式，并启发了神经算子的检查点策略；同时地质多样性首次支撑了田级跨地质场景的泛化基准研究。实验揭示的 OOD 失效模式可作为未来架构设计的参考。未来扩展方向包括 3D 波场/炮集生成与弹性波方程建模。论文同时提醒：该数据集面向 ML 方法开发，在真实场景部署前需进一步验证。

Abstract: Full waveform inversion (FWI) is the gold standard for subsurface imaging, with applications from carbon sequestration to energy and mineral exploration to earthquake hazard assessment. Machine learning approaches to FWI need field-scale, geologically diverse, and physically realistic training data, but existing resources such as Marmousi, SEAM, and OpenFWI fall short on spatial extent, temporal extent, geological diversity, and physical realism. We address these limitations with SubsurfaceGen, a GPU-accelerated generator for 3D velocity models and seismic data. Along with SubsurfaceGen, we release a paired dataset of 4,276 2D velocity slices, 5 s wavefields, and 8 s shot gathers drawn from 42 realistic, field-scale 3D velocity models, each spanning 10 km x 10 km laterally and 6.19 km deep at 10 m resolution. The dataset spans six geological settings -- four built with SubsurfaceGen and two drawn from prior sources -- relevant for carbon sequestration and hydrocarbon exploration. We use this dataset to evaluate neural operators on wavefield prediction and encoder-decoders on end-to-end velocity inversion, holding out one geological setting for out-of-distribution testing. These experiments surface failure modes at field-scale and demonstrate how SubsurfaceGen and the associated dataset can impact ML-based FWI.

</details>


### [118] [Early Prediction of Future Behavioral Strategy from Process Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30550)
*Robert Kasumba,Dennis Barbour,Chien-Ju Ho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PLVM（Process-Level Latent Variable Model），通过融合多个源任务的部分过程轨迹（process traces）来预测个体在未见目标任务中的行为策略。在PowerWash Simulator真实玩家数据和可控仿真实验中，PLVM均优于基于结果汇总和单任务过程模型的方法，验证了跨任务过程融合在早期行为策略预测中的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应系统（如智能导师、游戏关卡适配、人机协作）需要尽早推断个体在新任务中可能采取的行为策略。传统方法依赖聚合结果指标（分数、完成率等），会丢失行为过程信息；而单任务过程建模则混淆了稳定的个体倾向与任务特定布局。作者旨在研究能否从多个源任务的部分过程轨迹中提取可迁移的个体级行为结构，用于预测目标任务中的策略。

Method: PLVM由三部分组成：（1）任务特定的Transformer过程编码器，对每个源任务的局部轨迹进行自监督下一事件预测预训练后冻结；（2）跨任务融合网络，将多个任务嵌入拼接并映射为共享的个体级潜在表示z_i；（3）目标行为解码器，从z_i预测目标任务的策略标签（如Zone Planner/Hopper）。训练采用交叉熵损失，融合模块和解码器联合优化。基线包括：结果汇总模型（完成率、生产力等聚合指标）和单任务过程模型（仅使用一个源任务）。实验包含两部分——PowerWash真实遥测（Back Garden+Bungalow→Fire Station的Zone Planner/Hopper二分类，2,187名玩家）和配对网格世界仿真（8,000个智能体，Foraging+Cleaning→已知潜在表型A/B），后者用于机制检验。

Result: 在PowerWash二分类任务中，PLVM在60分钟观察点达到65.3%准确率（AUC 0.64），优于最佳单任务基线62.9%和结果基线53.0%（接近随机）。结果汇总在早期几乎无法区分未来Planners与Hoppers（AUC仅0.51-0.55），证明行为策略不是结果的简单代理。在仿真中，PLVM在互补任务设置下达86.6%（单任务最佳68.0%），弱共享信号下达74.8%（单任务56.6%），但在冗余任务中无增益（88.4% vs 89.4%），证实融合机制仅在任务提供互补或噪声视角时有效。潜空间可视化显示Hoppers与Planners存在可辨识的分布偏移。

Conclusion: 研究表明，未来行为策略可从早期任务的部分过程轨迹中预测，但难以从聚合结果中恢复；当多个源任务提供对同一潜在过程的不同视角时，跨任务过程融合可显著提升预测性能。PLVM的贡献在于将跨任务表示学习与个体级行为推断结合，适用于需要在目标行为充分展现前进行个性化决策的自适应系统。作者也讨论了局限：方法依赖任务间存在可迁移结构，当任务不相关或结果指标已充分时增益有限，并提示需关注行为画像的伦理风险。

Abstract: Adaptive systems often need to make task-specific decisions about people from limited evidence: a tutor may need to anticipate how a learner will approach a new problem, a game may need to adapt when a player enters a new level, and a human-AI system may need to infer whether a partner will persist with a plan or switch goals. These decisions depend on person-level tendencies that shape how people solve related tasks, but such tendencies are difficult to infer from standard behavioral evidence. One approach is to use aggregate outcome summaries, such as scores, completion rates, or productivity; these summaries are compact and available across tasks, but can collapse distinct behavioral processes into similar outcomes. Another approach is to use process-level traces, which record how behavior unfolds; however, process modeling within one task can entangle stable person-level tendencies with task-specific layout and affordances. In this work, we study early cross-task behavioral inference: whether partial source-task process traces can reveal transferable person-level structure that predicts strategy in a held-out target task. We introduce a Process-Level Latent Variable Model (PLVM), which encodes task-specific traces and fuses them into a shared person-level latent representation for cross-task prediction. In PowerWash Simulator, a naturalistic telemetry dataset of human gameplay, PLVM uses partial traces from two cleaning tasks to predict locally persistent Zone Planner behavior versus frequent Zone Hopper behavior in the held-out Fire Station level. Controlled simulations with known latent types show that cross-task fusion helps when source tasks reveal complementary dimensions of a shared latent process. These results suggest that process-level cross-task modeling can support early prediction of target-task strategy when observing sufficient target-task behavior is impractical.

</details>


### [119] [Destruction is a General Strategy to Learn Generation; Diffusion's Strength is to Take it Seriously; Exploration is the Future](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30553)
*Pierre-André Noël*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于扩散模型（Diffusion Models）的立场/观点论文，将扩散模型重新框定为一类通过"遮蔽输入信息并训练模型猜测被遮蔽部分"的机器学习技术家族成员，提出"先破坏后生成"（destroy-then-generate）的统一视角，并附带教程性内容与一种新型概率图模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望从更本质的视角理解扩散模型的工作机制，将其与其他"信息遮蔽式"学习方法（如掩码语言模型等）联系起来；动机在于扩散模型基于"破坏数据"的训练方式比传统手工设计的信息遮蔽技术更为灵活，尤其在数据稀缺场景下可能具有优势；同时探讨将强化学习技术迁移到扩散模型背景时可能出现的细微问题。

Method: 1. 概念框架：将扩散模型置于"信息遮蔽—信息猜测"的统一框架下，识别其"破坏式信息遮蔽"的本质特征；2. 教程性阐述：扩展"先破坏后生成"视角；3. 工具创新：引入一种新型的概率图模型（PGM）以辅助教程的表述与形式化；4. 探索性讨论：分析强化学习范式迁移至扩散模型上下文中的适配性问题，并探讨更具扩散原生性（diffusion-native）的探索策略。

Result: 该文为观点性/立场性论文，未报告实证性的实验结果。文中提出的主要"成果"为：（1）扩散模型的"破坏—生成"再诠释框架；（2）用于辅助教学/分析的新型概率图模型；（3）关于RL方法向扩散场景迁移的若干开放性问题与方向性思考。作者明确表示没有确定性的结论，但指出了若干值得关注的研究方向。

Conclusion: 扩散模型应被视为"信息遮蔽"学习范式中的一种特例，其数据破坏机制比人为设计的遮蔽方案更具灵活性与可调性，在数据稀缺等场景下具有潜在价值；将强化学习技术直接移植到扩散模型存在概念上的细微冲突，需要发展"扩散原生"的探索方法；论文以教程形式呈现理论，并提出新型PGM作为分析工具，整体为开放性、启发性的研究议程而非确定结论。

Abstract: I present diffusion models as part of a family of machine learning techniques that withhold information from a model's input and train it to guess the withheld information. I argue that diffusion's destroying approach to withholding is more flexible than typical hand-crafted information withholding techniques, providing a rich training playground that could be advantageous in some settings, notably data-scarce ones. I then address subtle issues that may arise when porting reinforcement learning techniques to the diffusion context, and wonder how such exploration problems could be addressed in more diffusion-native ways. I do not have definitive answers, but I do point my fingers in directions I deem interesting. A tutorial follows this thesis, expanding on the destroy-then-generate perspective. A novel kind of probabilistic graphical models is introduced to facilitate the tutorial's exposition.

</details>


### [120] [Supervised Training Rapidly Degrades Early Visual Cortex Alignment Across Biologically Plausible Learning Rules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30556)
*Nils Leutenegger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现,有监督训练会迅速且普遍地降低人工神经网络与人类早期视觉皮层(V1)的表征相似性,且破坏程度取决于学习规则的生物可信度。反向传播(BP)在单个训练周期内即损失90%的V1对齐度(Δr=-0.080),而局部学习规则(预测编码PC、脉冲时序依赖可塑性STDP)仅损失约25-31%,保留了更多类脑表征结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络在视觉任务上的训练使其表征与灵长类视觉皮层趋同,这被广泛视为"学习产生类脑计算"的证据。然而,近期研究发现未经训练的随机初始化网络在早期视觉区(V1)的对齐度上竟能匹配甚至超过训练后的网络,这一反常发现对"学习提升脑对齐"的假设构成挑战。已有研究仅在训练终态进行对比,训练过程中表征对齐度的动态变化尚属空白。理解这一动态过程有助于揭示随机权重的优势究竟是网络架构的内禀属性,还是训练主动造成的退化。

Method: 采用统一的卷积架构(3个卷积块+1个全连接层,Conv1/2/3分别32/64/128个3×3滤波器,后接512单元FC层),在CIFAR-10的8000张图像上训练40个周期,使用5个随机种子(42/123/456/789/1337)。比较四种学习规则:(1)反向传播(BP)——标准交叉熵+Adam;(2)反馈对齐(FA)——用固定随机反馈权重替代对称权重转置;(3)预测编码(PC)——每层通过转置卷积预测下层活动,T=10次迭代;(4)脉冲时序依赖可塑性(STDP)——基于泊松脉冲序列的指数STDP核更新权重。在8个训练检查点(epoch 0,1,2,5,10,20,30,40)提取模型表征。脑数据使用THINGS-fMRI数据集的720张图像、3名被试、6个ROI(V1/V2/V3/V4/LOC/IT)。通过计算模型与fMRI的表征不相似性矩阵(RDM)之间的Spearman秩相关来量化脑-模型对齐度,报告每个ROI的最佳层对齐度。使用配对单侧置换检验(2^5=32种符号分配,p值分辨力下限≈0.031)和Cohen's d效应量进行统计推断。

Result: (1)所有学习规则在单个训练周期内均显著降低V1对齐度,BP降幅最大(90%,r从0.102降至0.011),FA居中(49%,r从0.089降至0.044),PC和STDP降幅最小(25%和31%,r分别从0.093降至0.070、从0.097降至0.067)。(2)训练终态(epoch 40)排序稳定为:PC(r=0.064±0.012)>>STDP(0.059±0.010)>>BP(0.022±0.006)≈FA(0.019±0.006),所有规则均显著低于未训练基线(p=0.031)。(3)该退化模式在V2和V3中同样存在,在V4中减弱,在LOC和IT中消失或反转。(4)LOC出现微弱的相反趋势:BP在训练中LOC对齐度增幅最大(Δr=+0.011,从-0.001升至0.011),而PC和STDP几乎无变化(Δr≈-0.001至+0.001),但该变化未进行显著性检验。(5)种子间方差极低,所有方向性效应在5个种子中完全一致,Cohen's d>5。结论指向"全局误差信号(BP)比局部计算规则(PC/STDP)更激进地重塑早期表征"的假说,以及早期视觉区退化与高级对象选择性区增益之间的表征权衡。

Conclusion: 有监督训练普遍降低早期视觉皮层的对齐度,但退化程度系统性地依赖于学习规则。生物可信度最低的BP最具破坏性,局部学习规则(PC、STDP)保留更多V1类结构。这揭示了任务优化与表征类脑性之间存在根本性张力,任何皮层学习理论都必须调和这一矛盾。训练在V1造成的退化与LOC的小幅增益暗示全局梯度信号可能同时"破坏"低级视觉结构并"构建"任务相关的高级表征。研究局限性包括:简单共享架构可能不具代表性;CIFAR-10训练(32×32)与THINGS评估(224×224)之间存在分辨率和域偏移;STDP和PC为简化近似;fMRI仅3名被试;5种子的置换检验分辨力受限于p≈0.031;LOC变化未经显著性检验;绝对Spearman相关值较低(r<0.10),实际神经处理意义有待验证。

Abstract: Random, untrained neural networks consistently match or exceed trained networks in representational similarity to early visual cortex. This puzzling finding challenges the assumption that learning improves brain alignment. We investigate it by tracking representational similarity analysis (RSA) alignment to human fMRI data across training for four learning rules: backpropagation (BP), feedback alignment (FA), predictive coding (PC), and spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP). Using 720 object images from the THINGS database and fMRI data from three subjects across six visual ROIs, we measure Spearman correlations between model and brain representational dissimilarity matrices at eight training checkpoints (epochs 0-40). We find that (1) a single epoch of training reduces V1 alignment by 25-90%, depending on the learning rule; (2) backpropagation reduces V1 alignment most severely (delta r = -0.080), while predictive coding and STDP preserve substantially more (delta r ~ -0.04); and (3) a weaker, opposite tendency appears in object-selective cortex (LOC), where BP shows the largest increase in alignment during training, although the absolute change is small. These results suggest that untrained architectures capture low-level visual statistics through inductive biases alone, and that global error signals (BP) reshape early representations more aggressively than local learning rules (PC, STDP), which better preserve brain-like structure.

</details>


### [121] [Zeroth-Order Non-Log-Concave Sampling with Variance Reduction and Applications to Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30573)
*M. Berk Sahin,Behzad Sharif,Abolfazl Hashemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对高维非对数凹分布在黑盒设置下的采样难题，提出了一种方差缩减的零阶Langevin采样方法及零阶APMC（ZO-APMC）后验采样算法。其核心贡献是设计了一种新颖的零阶梯度估计器，将每轮迭代的函数评估次数从标准ZO估计器的O(d)降至O(1)，并首次建立了非对数凹零阶采样及黑盒逆问题后验采样的非渐近收敛保证。在MRI重建和黑洞成像任务上取得了黑盒方法中的最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高维非对数凹分布采样场景中，标准的Langevin Monte Carlo（LMC）方法依赖梯度信息，但许多实际应用（如科学模拟器、商业MRI系统、闭源物理模型）无法获取梯度信息，只能通过函数评估（即零阶/黑盒设置）进行采样。现有的零阶采样方法存在两个核心问题：（1）梯度估计器方差大，控制方差需批量大小随维度d线性增长O(d)，导致高维场景下的计算和内存成本不可承受；（2）非对数凹设置下的非渐近收敛理论缺失。同样，对于使用预训练SGM先验的黑盒逆问题后验采样，已有方法依赖启发式近似，缺乏严格的收敛保证。

Method: 方法包含两部分：（1）方差缩减零阶梯度估计器：受STORM类方差缩减技术（Li et al., 2021）启发，以概率p使用大批量b的ZO估计，以概率1-p利用相邻迭代的强相关性，递归地利用小批量b'更新前一步的估计。关键引理（命题1）给出了估计误差的递推上界，揭示了方差缩减与误差传播之间的权衡关系。（2）ZO-APMC算法：将方差缩减ZO估计器与退火LMC（APMC框架）结合，用于黑盒逆问题后验采样，其中SGM先验提供扰动得分的近似。理论分析基于采样版本的稳定点分析（Balasubramanian et al., 2022），利用Fisher信息（FI）作为KL散度在Wasserstein空间梯度的模拟量。在势函数Lipschitz连续（假设1、2）和Poincaré不等式（假设3）等条件下，建立了关于ε-相对FI和平方全变距离的收敛保证。

Result: 主要理论结果：（1）定理1：在常数步长参数设置下，方差缩减ZO-LMC经O(d⁷L_m⁴/ε⁴)次迭代后达到ε-相对FI精度，每轮O(1)次函数评估。（2）推论1：在Poincaré条件下，经O(d⁷L_m⁴C_PI⁴/ε⁴)次迭代后达到ε-平方TV距离精度。（3）定理2：使用衰减参数时，时间平均律弱收敛到目标分布。（4）定理3/推论2：将上述结果扩展到ZO-APMC后验采样，在考虑退火调度和SGM估计误差后获得相同迭代复杂度。（5）定理4：建立后验采样的弱收敛性。实验结果：（a）合成实验（双峰GMM先验）：验证了不同p值下ZO-APMC的FI收敛行为，弱收敛到真实后验；（b）MRI重建（256×256脑部图像）：ZO-APMC（PSNR 35.29 dB）显著优于所有黑盒基线（SCG 7.1、DPG 32.17、EnKG 31.32、Forward-GSG 27.8、Central-GSG 27.78），接近有梯度访问的APMC（36.55 dB）；（c）黑洞成像（64×64 GRMHD图像）：ZO-APMC在所有指标上达到最优或接近最优，PSNR 26.71 dB，优于所有基线；（d）Navier-Stokes逆问题：ZO-APMC（NRMSE 0.459）性能与DPG（0.325）相当但弱于EnKG（0.120），因高非线性PDE下ZO高斯扰动可能使输入偏离数据流形。

Conclusion: 本文建立了非对数凹零阶采样及黑盒SGM后验采样的首个理论框架，核心创新在于将方差缩减技术从优化领域成功迁移到采样领域，使每轮函数评估次数与维度d无关（O(1) vs O(d)），大幅降低了高维黑盒采样的内存和计算成本。理论保证涵盖了非渐近复杂度（ε-FI、平方TV距离）和弱渐近收敛性。在三个实际逆问题上的实验验证了方法的有效性，尤其在MRI和黑洞成像中达到黑盒方法的最优水平。然而方法在高度非线性PDE逆问题（如Navier-Stokes）上存在局限性，ZO高斯扰动可能影响求解器稳定性。未来工作方向包括将方法扩展到欠阻尼Langevin动力学和潜空间扩散模型以进一步提高采样效率，并可考虑将方差缩减机制与STORM估计器结合以获得确定性的逐轮复杂度上界。

Abstract: Sampling from high-dimensional, non-log-concave distributions with unnormalized densities remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning, particularly in black-box settings where gradient information is inaccessible or computationally prohibitive. While Langevin dynamics provides a principled framework for sampling when gradients are accessible, its extension to the black-box settings suffers from high variance and lacks non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for non-log-concave sampling. To address these limitations, we propose a variance-reduced zeroth-order Langevin sampling method. Our method employs a gradient estimator that substantially reduces the variance of the classical batched zeroth-order estimator and eliminates the unfavorable dimensional dependence of the batch size required for accurate estimation, enabling practical and stable sampling. We establish the first non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for zeroth-order non-log-concave sampling in terms of $\varepsilon$-relative Fisher information, and, under a Poincaré inequality assumption, squared total variation distance. We further propose ZO-APMC, a posterior sampling algorithm for black-box inverse problems with pre-trained score-based generative priors, establishing the first non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for such methods. We validate our theory through synthetic experiments and demonstrate strong empirical performance on practical linear and nonlinear inverse problems.

</details>


### [122] [Learning Transferable Predictability Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30592)
*Diyali Goswami,Auroop R. Ganguly*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GON（Gauge-Fixed Ordinal Network），通过锚点-方差目标函数将轨迹窗口的标量可预测性评分固定在共享的序数坐标上，实现跨动力系统的零样本可预测性评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的确定性-随机性判别方法仅在单一系统内有效，所得评分缺乏跨系统一致的数值解释能力。论文将"序数评分的规范自由度"（gauge freedom，即排序监督仅确定序关系但不固定数值坐标）识别为跨系统迁移的结构性障碍，指出事后逐系统重标定无法替代零样本迁移所需的统一坐标约定。

Method: （1）构建五级可预测性阶梯 L0–L4（稳定确定性→弱混沌→强混沌→结构化随机→无结构噪声）；（2）以2-jet特征（位置、速度、加速度，经Savitzky–Golay平滑后中心差分获得）作为输入，暴露局部轨迹几何；（3）采用六层膨胀残差TCN编码器配合多尺度池化与两层MLP头，输出经tanh平滑裁剪；（4）核心创新为锚点-方差损失：将各级别分数均值固定到目标坐标{-4,-2,0,+2,+4}，同时约束级内标准差≤0.3；（5）在12个耗散混沌ODE系统上训练，在5个完全未见的系统（Thomas、Tigan、Newton–Leipnik、Rabinovich–Fabrikant、强迫摆）上评估零样本与少样本迁移。

Result: GON在五级序数指标上获得β_norm=0.559，显著优于回归/分类/CORAL基线（0.46–0.48）；预训练初始化在所有窗口预算（k=5–100）下均稳定优于随机初始化，差距不随k增大而消失；零样本迁移在随机边界L2→L3和L3→L4最强，强迫摆与Thomas因正弦向量场几何未见而L2→L3边界无法解析；锚点消融将迁移β降低47%，证明坐标稳定性而非序数一致性才是迁移的关键；2-jet较原始状态将迁移β从1.132提升至1.504，时序乱置与随机通道对照证明增益来自位置-速度-加速度的相干几何结构；模型在20 dB SNR、30%时间丢弃、4-bit量化下仍保持序数结构。

Conclusion: 规范固定（gauge-fixing）是跨系统序数可预测性评分缺失的关键环节；成对判别与全局序数一致性是可分离的性质，跨系统迁移需要稳定的数值坐标而非仅序数排序；该框架为可预测性评估、模型选择与早期预警诊断提供了无需系统特定标定的统一度量。局限在于仅覆盖低维耗散系统，向高维、保守动力学及真实信号的扩展有待验证。

Abstract: We study the problem of assigning a scalar score to a short trajectory window that reflects its position on an ordered continuum of predictability regimes, spanning structured deterministic dynamics to unstructured stochastic noise. Existing methods address deterministic-versus-stochastic discrimination within a single system and do not produce scores with a consistent numerical interpretation across systems. We formalize this as ordinal estimation over a five-level predictability ladder and identify a structural source of cross-system ambiguity: ranking supervision alone leaves the score coordinate unfixed up to a monotone reparameterization, which we term the gauge freedom of ordinal scoring. We propose the Gauge-Fixed Ordinal Network (GON), a temporal convolutional model trained with an anchor-and-variance objective that pins level-wise score means to shared target coordinates. GON operates on 2-jet features that expose local trajectory geometry, preserved by smooth flows and disrupted by stochastic surrogate procedures. On five held-out dynamical systems, initializing from a pretrained GON checkpoint consistently outperforms training from scratch across all window budgets, with adaptation depth reflecting geometric proximity to the training family. Zero-shot scores retain ordinal structure at the stochastic boundary, where surrogate procedures most strongly disrupt nonlinear geometry, and pretrained initialization consistently beats scratch across all window budgets. Pairwise discrimination and globally coherent ordinal scoring are distinct properties requiring a stable score coordinate for cross-system transfer, with direct implications for predictability assessment, model selection, and early-warning diagnostics across natural and engineered dynamical systems.

</details>


### [123] [Improving Relative Representations with Learned Anchors and Whitened Inner Products](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30596)
*Oscar Thorsted Svendsen,Nikolaj Holst Jakobsen,Fabian Mager,Hiba Nassar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PARAM（通过可学习锚点进行参数化表示）和WIP（白化内积）两个组件，改进相对表示（RR）方法以实现跨模型的零样本潜空间通信。核心思想是用凸混合学习的锚点替代随机采样锚点，用协方差感知的相似度度量替代余弦相似度，从而更好地处理Transformer等架构的各向异性几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 独立训练的神经网络模型通常收敛到不兼容的潜在表示，这构成了模块化AI系统的主要障碍。现有相对表示（RR）方法依赖随机采样锚点和余弦相似度，存在两个关键缺陷：(1) 随机锚点可能覆盖不足或冗余，导致低秩相对特征和信息丢失；(2) 余弦相似度只保留角度信息、丢弃幅值信息，对Transformer的各向异性潜在空间不稳定。这些问题违反了跨空间对齐（O_al）和信息保持（O_inf）两个目标。

Method: 方法包含两个核心组件：(1) PARAM（参数化锚点表示）：将锚点定义为数据点的凸混合，通过共享的随机矩阵P（行随机约束）从支持集生成锚点；优化目标包括单空间损失（覆盖度L_cov通过软k-means、正交性L_orth惩罚相关锚点、长度控制L_len约束L2范数）和多空间损失（对称InfoNCE L_symNCE用于跨空间对齐）。(2) WIP（白化内积）：在白化坐标系中计算标准内积，s_WIP(x,a) = (x-μ)^T Σ^{-1} (a-μ)，使用带收缩的协方差估计（λ=0.15）保证数值稳定性；在非收缩形式下对仿射变换完全不变，同时保留幅值和角度信息。零样本评估流程：训练时排除测试编码器，训练分类器后直接部署到保留编码器上。

Result: 在CIFAR-100（粗粒度）图像分类中，PARAM-WIP显著优于随机-余弦基线，特别是在CNN（RexNet）与Transformer（ViT）之间的跨架构缝合中；如RexNet测试编码器下，PARAM Multi的F1达到88.14%，而基线仅71.11%。在MARC跨语言文本分类中，PARAM Multi在所有语言对上均达到接近绝对分类的性能（如法语测试下93.75% vs 绝对93.76%）。在小型语言模型（GPT-2、TinyLlama、Gemma-1.5B）之间的零样本检索任务中，R@1从基线的0.33-9.94%提升到PARAM-WIP的81.61-95.72%，R@5接近100%。消融实验表明WIP单独使用会因随机锚点接近原点而放大噪声，必须与学习锚点结合才能发挥最佳效果。附加的MNIST重建实验在强各向异性条件下证明PARAM-WIP能产生与绝对基线几乎一致的高保真重建，而基线则完全失败。

Conclusion: 本文通过形式化潜空间几何与相对坐标系之间的关系，为零样本潜空间通信提供了实用且可扩展的路径。PARAM和WIP共同解决了标准相对表示的几何和信息瓶颈，实现跨视觉和语言编码器（包括高度异构的小型语言模型）几乎无损的任务相关信息转移。该工作为模块化AI架构中编码器和解码器的可互换性奠定了基础，无需代价高昂的再训练或适配。

Abstract: Independently trained neural models typically converge to incompatible latent representations, creating a fundamental barrier to highly modular AI systems. While Relative Representations (RR) address this by mapping absolute coordinates to a shared space defined by similarities to common anchor points, traditional implementations rely on randomly sampled anchors and cosine similarity, which frequently fail to capture the anisotropic geometries of modern architectures like Transformers. In this work, we propose a robust framework for cross-model communication based on two improvements. We learn anchors as robust semantic prototypes and utilize a geometry-aware similarity metric which preserves discriminative magnitude information and is invariant to affine shifts. Our approach demonstrates significant gains in performance and consistency across vision and language tasks. Notably, it enables nearly lossless information transfer and stable zero-shot communication even between highly heterogeneous architectures, such as small language models of varying scales.

</details>


### [124] [ScaleMAP: Preserving Local Density and Neighborhood Structure in Low-Dimensional Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30597)
*Rajas Poorna,Marcus T. Cicerone*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ScaleMAP提出了一种通过变量替换（而非增加损失项）将局部尺度信息重新注入UMAP低维嵌入的方法。该方法用原始空间中两端点局部半径的几何平均值对嵌入位移进行重缩放，在保持UMAP邻居保持能力的同时，实现了DensMAP级别的密度保真度，并能恢复被UMAP折叠的稀疏结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UMAP、t-SNE、PaCMAP等非线性降维方法在构建k近邻图时采用自适应带宽归一化局部距离，抹去了原始数据的局部尺度信息。这不仅导致相对簇大小失真，更严重的是会抑制或完全丢失稀疏但具有科学价值的结构——例如细胞类型之间的过渡桥、高光谱图像中的窄谱峰、以及流式细胞术中跨越多个数量级的密度差异。现有的DensMAP方法通过在UMAP损失函数中增加密度惩罚项来纠正此问题，但由于该惩罚项与UMAP的吸引-排斥力相竞争，会将部分点散射到远离其真实邻域的位置，降低了稀疏区域的可解释性。

Method: ScaleMAP的核心创新是采用"变量替换"策略而非"竞争性目标"策略。具体而言，将UMAP中用于计算吸引和排斥力的平方距离 d²ᵢⱼ 替换为重缩放距离 d̃²ᵢⱼ = ‖yᵢ - yⱼ‖² / √(rᵢrⱼ)，其中 rᵢ 和 rⱼ 是原始空间中两点的局部半径（按UMAP图权重的加权RMS距离）。由于重缩放同时对称地作用于吸引步和排斥步，UMAP原有的局部吸引-排斥平衡得以保持。稀疏区域（大半径r）的点受力较弱，因此在嵌入空间中被自然展开；密集区域的点则被紧密压缩。作者还引入了一个缩放系数λ（默认λ=1）来控制重缩放强度，以及使用P₉₅百分位数对局部半径进行归一化。该方法以O(n)的额外开销对每个点预先计算局部半径，并可直接推广到PaCMAP（称为Scale-PaCMAP）。消融实验表明，使用单端点半径（非几何平均）会导致嵌入碎片化，证明对称性是关键设计选择。

Result: 在4个标准基准（MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、COIL-20、Mammoth）和3个科学数据集（Tabula Sapiens转录组264,824个免疫细胞、C. elegans性腺BCARS高光谱图像、人骨髓流式细胞术数据）上的实验表明：（1）ScaleMAP在密度保持方面（R²）达到与DensMAP相当或更好的水平（如HSI上R²=0.81 vs 0.59，流式细胞术上0.80 vs 0.68）；（2）在邻居保持方面（kNN recall@15）保持UMAP级别水平，在5/7个数据集上至少与UMAP持平；（3）DensMAP的失联点比例是UMAP的2-23倍，而ScaleMAP的失联点比例与UMAP相当；（4）在类别混合指标上，ScaleMAP在所有有标签数据集上均最低；（5）转录组数据中，ScaleMAP恢复了单核细胞-中性粒细胞和B-T细胞之间已知的发育过渡桥（被UMAP折叠），高光谱数据中恢复了UMAP忽略的稀疏谱峰，流式细胞术数据中以17个数量级保持密度结构（R²=0.81）。该方法还改善了全局距离顺序保持（流式细胞术Spearman ρ=0.97，显著超过UMAP的0.74和PaCMAP的0.78）。Scale-PaCMAP在所有数据集上一致改善了PaCMAP的密度保持。运行时间约为UMAP的2倍，与DensMAP相当。

Conclusion: ScaleMAP通过变量替换将局部尺度信息重新整合到UMAP的优化过程中，成功解决了现有方法在密度保持与邻居保持之间的权衡困境。它是唯一在测试中不牺牲任一性能维度的方法——结合了UMAP级邻居保持、DensMAP级密度保真度和PaCMAP级全局顺序。恢复被现有方法遗漏的科学结构（转录组过渡桥、稀疏谱特征、跨越17个数量级的密度变化）证明了尺度信息是邻域保持嵌入中缺失的关键成分。该方法在PaCMAP上的成功推广表明这种局部尺度修正是一个通用原则。论文建议将ScaleMAP作为需要忠实表示尺度的高维数据可视化的默认嵌入方法。局限包括：在某些数据集上失联点略多于UMAP；在各向异性邻域上（标量局部半径表示不足）会出现结构压缩；2D合成数据集对邻域大小更敏感；尚未在高维嵌入空间中严格基准测试。

Abstract: Nonlinear dimensionality-reduction methods such as UMAP and PaCMAP adaptively normalize local distances during graph construction, erasing neighborhood scale from the data. This distorts more than relative cluster sizes: sparse structures like bridges between transitioning cell types and narrow spectral spikes in hyperspectral images can be suppressed or lost entirely. DensMAP adds a density penalty to correct this, but this penalty competes with UMAP's attraction-repulsion forces, scattering points far from their neighborhoods. ScaleMAP takes a different approach: each pairwise embedding displacement is divided by the geometric mean of the two endpoints' original-space local radii, re-injecting scale information as a change of variables rather than as a competing objective. Across standard benchmarks and scientific datasets from transcriptomics, hyperspectral imaging, and flow cytometry, ScaleMAP matches DensMAP on density preservation while maintaining UMAP-level neighborhood preservation. In transcriptomic data, it recovers sparse bridges between cell populations that UMAP collapses; in flow cytometry, it faithfully represents density structure across 17 orders of magnitude. The same principle applied to PaCMAP yields consistently improved density preservation, suggesting the approach generalizes beyond UMAP.

</details>


### [125] [AMNESIA: A Large Scale Medical Unlearning Benchmark Suite with Disease-Informed Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30599)
*Saeedeh Davoudi,Reihaneh Iranmanesh,Ophir Frieder,Nazli Goharian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 AMNESIA,首个面向医疗领域的大规模开源机器遗忘(machine unlearning)基准,包含来自 11 种疾病类别、8,820 份患者病历的 70,560 个问答对,涵盖事实性与推理性问题,并在随机患者级与疾病级两种遗忘场景下评估了四种主流遗忘方法,提出了一种新的疾病关键词泄露评估指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗知识持续更新,且受 GDPR、HIPAA 等隐私法规约束,需从已训练医疗大模型中选择性删除特定患者数据;然而现有遗忘基准多依赖合成数据或小规模通用数据,临床遗忘场景尚未得到充分研究,亟需一个大规模、真实临床病历驱动的医疗遗忘基准。

Method: 1) 数据集构建:基于 PMC-Patients-v2 抽取 8,820 份患者病历,使用 GPT-5.4-nano 按 CDC 疾病分类为 11 类,再由 GPT-5-nano 为每位患者生成 4 条事实性 QA 和 4 条推理性 QA,共 70,560 对,并通过三 LLM 评审面板(MedGemma-27B、Qwen3-32B、GPT-5-mini)及人工标注验证质量;2) 数据划分:支持随机患者级(5%–25%)与疾病级(Cancer、Infectious/Immune、Cardiovascular)两种遗忘/保留划分,并预留 holdout 集;3) 模型:以 LLaMA 3-8B 为基座,经病历预训练和指令微调后,在第 7 层选择性遗忘;4) 评估:评测 RMU、GradDiff、KL-Min、SimNPO 四种方法,采用 Model Utility(MU)、Answer Forget Efficacy(AFE)、Degradation Score(DS)及新提出的基于 scispaCy 疾病关键词匹配的 Leakage Score(LS)指标。

Result: 1) 随机患者级遗忘:RMU 与 SimNPO 几乎无法有效遗忘(MU 高、AFE 低),KL-Min 通过输出退化实现高 AFE 但 MU 接近 0,GradDiff 在 5–15% 时较平衡但 20–25% 时崩溃;2) 疾病级遗忘:RMU 和 SimNPO 随遗忘集增大遗忘效果提升(癌症 25% 时 AFE 约 0.6),但同病种保留患者 MU 显著下降(癌症患者从 ~0.83 降至 ~0.37),而非同病种患者 MU 保持 ~0.90–0.95;3) 关键词泄露:GradDiff/KL-Min 的 LS 接近 0 源于输出崩溃(DS 高),而 RMU/SimNPO 在疾病级下 LS 随遗忘集增大而下降;4) 关键发现:holdout 评估显示模型遗忘的是具体 QA 而非患者病历级信息,通过新问句仍可恢复遗忘患者的相关知识。

Conclusion: AMNESIA 揭示了现有遗忘方法在医疗场景的根本局限:随机患者级遗忘要么无效要么导致模型崩溃;疾病级遗忘虽随批量增大而改善,但会侵蚀同病种保留患者的模型效用;模型仅遗忘训练 QA 对而非底层患者信息,且仍存在疾病关键词泄露风险。文章呼吁开发能够区分个体患者与共享医学知识的医疗专用遗忘技术,并以 AMNESIA 作为推动该领域发展的标准基准。

Abstract: Medical knowledge is continuously evolving. This creates a need to update or selectively forget information encoded in already-trained medical LLMs. Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training data from a model without full retraining. Yet, existing unlearning benchmarks rely on synthetic or small-scale general data, leaving clinical unlearning understudied. We introduce AMNESIA, the first large-scale, open source benchmark for medical unlearning, with 70,560 question-answer pairs from 8,820 patient notes across 11 disease categories. AMNESIA includes both factual questions testing direct recall and reasoning questions testing clinical inference. We use it to evaluate four widely used unlearning methods at both random patient and disease-level, and introduce a new metric for detecting leakage of medical terminology. We show that unlearning individual patients erodes knowledge of others with the same condition, calling for methods that can better separate patients from shared clinical knowledge.

</details>


### [126] [The Fast Mixing Mechanism for Differential Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30600)
*Omri Lev,Moshe Shenfeld,Vishwak Srinivasan,Katrina Ligett,Ashia C. Wilson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于快速变换（如Hadamard变换）的新型差分隐私（DP）草图机制FastMix，通过结合大型快速草图（SRHT）和小尺寸高斯草图，在保持与纯高斯草图相当隐私保证的同时显著提升计算效率。该机制首次实现了快速的差分隐私普通最小二乘法（DP-OLS），在大规模线性回归实验中相较现有最优方法（IHM）获得2-3倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分隐私（DP）线性回归中，基于高斯草图的方法虽具有强效用保证，但因密集高斯矩阵乘法计算成本高（O(nkd)），无法提供通常与草图方法相关的计算优势。早期Upadhyay（2014）提出的基于SRHT的快速DP草图机制虽计算更快，但隐私性能远不如高斯草图。因此，如何设计既快速又具有可比噪声预算的DP机制是一个核心开放问题。

Method: FastMix机制采用"快速草图+高斯草图"的两阶段混合策略：（1）使用大型快速草图矩阵S_f（如SRHT，列范数为1）压缩数据集得到Z=S_fX；（2）对Z应用小尺寸高斯草图并添加校准噪声。隐私分析通过Rényi DP（RDP）框架，利用高斯分布间的Rényi散度闭式公式，证明该机制满足(α, 25αk₁/(32γ²))-RDP保证，其中γ=(λ_min^Z+σ²)/C²_{S_fX}。通过Laplace机制私有化估计所需的λ_min和m̂值。应用到DP-OLS时，将FastMix嵌入迭代Hessian混合（IHM）算法中形成FastIHM算法。

Result: 主要理论结果：（1）FastMix的(ε,δ)-DP保证为ε=O(2/ω + 25k₁/(32γ²) + √(25k₁log(1/δ))/(32γ²))；（2）当S_f为SRHT时，FastMix运行时间为O(nd log n + k₁k₂d + k₂d² + d³)，在nd主导情形下匹配SRHT成本；（3）FastIHM的效用保证与现有最优DP-OLS方法在良态设计矩阵情形下相匹配，额外退化因子为(1+m̄)；（4）实验显示在Black Friday、Beijing、YearsMSD、Rossman、合成数据集上，FastIHM相对IHM实现2-3倍加速，且在n/d比极大的航空数据集上加速达14-42倍。

Conclusion: 本文提出的FastMix机制是首个在有利条件下隐私退化仅为常数倍的快速DP草图机制，填补了非私有快速草图与私有草图之间的空白。FastIHM算法是首个具有可证明精度保证的快速DP-OLS方法。未来工作方向包括：研究稀疏草图或低相干性草图以替代SRHT+高斯的串联结构、探索在私有设置下的自适应草图、推广至二阶DP凸优化方法。

Abstract: Randomized sketching is a central tool for compressing large-scale optimization problems while preserving accuracy. In particular, sketches that are based on structured matrices, such as the Hadamard matrix, can be applied efficiently and often yield solutions that approximate those of the original problem at much lower computational cost. In differential privacy (DP), Gaussian sketching has been used to solve DP linear regression, beginning with \citet{sheffet2017differentially, sheffet2019old} and later refined by \citet{lev2025gaussianmix, lev2026near}. However, although these methods achieve strong utility guarantees, they usually do not improve runtime over classical DP approaches. In this work, we introduce a new DP sketching mechanism based on fast transforms, which, in certain cases, matches the runtime of classical fast sketching methods. We prove state-of-the-art privacy guarantees for this mechanism and show that, in favorable regimes, they match those of the Gaussian sketch up to a constant factor. As an application, we combine this mechanism with recent sketch-based methods for DP linear regression to obtain a new algorithm with strong utility and improved runtime.
